```{r setup}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2); library(dplyr); library(tidyr)
  library(scales);  library(knitr); library(kableExtra)
  library(stringr); library(gridExtra); library(ggrepel)
})
if (requireNamespace("pheatmap",     quietly=TRUE)) library(pheatmap)
if (requireNamespace("scales",       quietly=TRUE)) library(scales)
# GenomicRanges loaded without library() to avoid masking dplyr::rename
.gr_available <- requireNamespace("GenomicRanges", quietly=TRUE) &&
                 requireNamespace("IRanges",       quietly=TRUE) &&
                 requireNamespace("S4Vectors",     quietly=TRUE)


# ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
safe_read <- function(path, ...) {
  if (!is.null(path) && file.exists(path))
    tryCatch(read.table(path, header=TRUE, sep="\t",
                        check.names=FALSE, ...), error=function(e) NULL)
  else NULL
}

go_bar <- function(go_df, title, fill_low, fill_high, n=20, padj_thr=0.05) {
  if (is.null(go_df) || !any(go_df$p.adjust < padj_thr, na.rm=TRUE)) {
    cat("No significant terms at padj <", padj_thr, "\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  go_df |> filter(p.adjust < padj_thr) |> arrange(p.adjust) |> head(n) |>
    mutate(neg_lp = pmin(-log10(p.adjust), 50),
           Description = str_trunc(Description, 55)) |>
    ggplot(aes(x=reorder(Description, neg_lp), y=neg_lp, fill=neg_lp)) +
    geom_col(show.legend=FALSE) +
    geom_text(aes(label=GeneRatio), hjust=-0.1, size=2.8) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_gradient(low=fill_low, high=fill_high) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand=expansion(mult=c(0,0.25))) +
    labs(title=title, x=NULL, y="-log10(BH-adjusted p-value)") +
    theme_minimal(base_size=10)
}

# ── TE macro classification (available globally) ─────────────────────────────
classify_macro <- function(fid) dplyr::case_when(
  grepl("^Alu|^MIR|SINE",      fid, ignore.case=TRUE) ~ "SINE",
  grepl("^L1|^L2|^CR1|LINE",   fid, ignore.case=TRUE) ~ "LINE",
  grepl("^LTR|^MLT|^THE|^MER[0-9]|^HERV|^ERV|LTR",
        fid, ignore.case=TRUE)                         ~ "LTR/ERV",
  grepl("^Tigger|^Charlie|^hAT|^Mariner|^MER[A-Z]|DNA",
        fid, ignore.case=TRUE)                         ~ "DNA transposon",
  grepl("^SVA",                fid, ignore.case=TRUE)  ~ "SVA",
  TRUE                                                 ~ "Other TE"
)
# Satellite macrocategory classification
classify_sat_macro <- function(fid) dplyr::case_when(
  grepl("^ACRO|^HSAT|^SAT[0-9]|^TAR1", fid, ignore.case=TRUE) ~ "peri-centromeric",
  grepl("^ALR|^CER|^CENSAT",           fid, ignore.case=TRUE)  ~ "alpha-satellite",
  grepl("^BSR|^BSAT",                  fid, ignore.case=TRUE)  ~ "beta-satellite",
  grepl("^GSATII|^GSATX|^GSAT",        fid, ignore.case=TRUE)  ~ "gamma-satellite",
  grepl("^MSR1|^SATR",                 fid, ignore.case=TRUE)  ~ "micro-satellite",
  grepl("^LSau|^LSAU",                 fid, ignore.case=TRUE)  ~ "LSAU",
  TRUE                                                          ~ "other satellite"
)
# dominant macro from comma-separated family list (used in 4.3)
dominant_macro_from_families <- function(fam_str) {
  fams <- trimws(strsplit(as.character(fam_str), ",")[[1]])
  macros <- classify_macro(fams)
  if (length(macros) == 0) return("Other TE")
  names(sort(table(macros), decreasing=TRUE))[1]
}

# Executive Summary {.unnumbered}

```{r summary-box}
# Count from DE genes actually tested (not from full annotation)
if (!is.null(de_genes) && !is.null(gene_map)) {
  gid_col_s <- if ("gene_id" %in% colnames(de_genes)) "gene_id" else colnames(de_genes)[ncol(de_genes)]
  tested_types <- gene_map$gene_type[match(de_genes[[gid_col_s]], gene_map$gene_id)]
  n_pc  <- sum(tested_types == "protein_coding", na.rm=TRUE)
  n_lnc <- sum(tested_types == "lncRNA", na.rm=TRUE)
} else if (!is.null(gene_map)) {
  n_pc  <- sum(gene_map$gene_type=="protein_coding")
  n_lnc <- sum(gene_map$gene_type=="lncRNA")
} else {
  n_pc  <- "N/A"; n_lnc <- "N/A"
}
n_te  <- if (!is.null(te_counts))  nrow(te_counts)  else "N/A"
n_sat <- if (!is.null(sat_counts)) nrow(sat_counts) else "N/A"
n_circ<- if (!is.null(circ_counts)) nrow(circ_counts) else 0

  sum(!is.na(circ_de$padj) & circ_de$padj<padj_thr &
      abs(circ_de$log2FoldChange)>lfc_thr)
} else 0

data.frame(

                sprintf("lncRNA genes (of %s tested)",format(if(!is.null(de_genes))nrow(de_genes) else 0,big.mark=",")),
                "TE families detected","Satellite families detected",

                "DE TE families","DE satellite families","DE circRNA loci"),
  Count     = c(format(n_pc,big.mark=","), format(n_lnc,big.mark=","),
                format(n_te,big.mark=","),  format(n_sat,big.mark=","),
                format(n_circ,big.mark=","),

                sprintf("padj<%.2f", padj_thr),
                sprintf("padj<%.2f", padj_thr),
                sprintf("padj<%.2f & |LFC|>%.1f", padj_thr, lfc_thr))
) |>

# Quality Control

## Trimming (fastp)

```{r qc-trim}
if (!is.null(trim_stats)) {
  sids_comp <- if (!is.null(coldata)) coldata$sample_id else character(0)
  ts <- if (length(sids_comp) > 0) trim_stats[trim_stats$sample_id %in% sids_comp, ] else trim_stats
  ts |>
    mutate(pct_kept=round(reads_after/reads_before*100,1)) |>
    select(any_of(c("sample_id","condition","reads_before","reads_after",
                    "pct_kept","q30_rate","mean_len_r1"))) |>
    kable(caption=sprintf("Per-sample trimming statistics (fastp) — %s vs %s. Adapter auto-detection; Q20 quality filter; minimum length 36bp.",
                          p$treatment, p$control)) |>
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options=c("striped","hover","condensed"))
}
```

## Mapping (STAR two-pass)

```{r qc-map}
if (!is.null(strand_df)) {
  # Filter to comparison samples
  sids_comp <- if (!is.null(coldata)) coldata$sample_id else character(0)
  sd <- if (length(sids_comp) > 0) strand_df[strand_df$sample_id %in% sids_comp, ] else strand_df
  # Add config strandedness column for clarity
  cfg_strand <- "FR (2-strand, from config)"
  sd_show <- sd |>
    mutate(strand_config = cfg_strand) |>
    select(any_of(c("sample_id","n_input_reads","pct_uniquely_mapped",
                    "pct_multimapped","frac_fr","frac_rf","frac_failed",
                    "strandedness","strand_config")))
  kable(sd_show,
        caption=paste0(
          "STAR mapping rates and strandedness per sample. ",
          "**strandedness** = RSeQC detection (classifies as 'unstranded' when frac_fr < 0.80; ",
          "frac_fr ~0.55-0.68 here because chromatin-associated RNA has high failed-assignment fraction ",
          "— reads spanning splice sites in both orientations). ",
          "**strand_config** = strandedness actually used by featureCounts (from sequencing.strandedness in config.yaml). ",
          "These two values intentionally differ: RSeQC detection is informative but not used for quantification.")) |>
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options=c("striped","hover","condensed"))
}
```

## Sample QC — PCA and Correlation

```{r pca-plot, fig.height=5, fig.width=7, fig.cap="PCA of samples based on top 500 most variable genes (log2 normalised counts). PC1 and PC2 percentages indicate variance explained. Samples coloured by condition."}
if (!is.null(pca_coords)) {
  ggplot(pca_coords, aes(x=PC1, y=PC2, color=condition, label=sample_id)) +
    geom_point(size=5, alpha=0.9) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(size=3.5, show.legend=FALSE) +
    scale_color_manual(values=col_cond, na.value="grey60") +
    labs(title="PCA — Top 500 most variable genes",
         x=paste0("PC1 (", round(var(pca_coords$PC1)/sum(apply(pca_coords[,c("PC1","PC2")],2,var))*100,1),"%)"),
         y="PC2", color="Condition") +
    theme_minimal(base_size=13) + theme(legend.position="top")
} else {

")
}
```

```{r corr-heatmap, fig.height=5, fig.width=6, fig.cap="Sample-sample Pearson correlation matrix based on log2 normalised counts. Values close to 1 indicate high similarity; replicates within the same condition should cluster together."}
if (!is.null(norm_counts) && ncol(norm_counts) >= 2) {
  nc_log <- log2(as.matrix(norm_counts) + 1)
  cor_mat <- cor(nc_log, method="pearson")

  ann_df <- data.frame(Condition=conditions[colnames(cor_mat)],
                       row.names=colnames(cor_mat))
  known_conds <- unique(ann_df$Condition[!is.na(ann_df$Condition) &
                                          ann_df$Condition %in% names(col_cond)])
  use_ann <- length(known_conds) > 0
  ann_colors <- if (use_ann) list(Condition=col_cond[known_conds]) else list()

  pheatmap::pheatmap(
    cor_mat,
    color=colorRampPalette(c("#2C3E50","#85C1E9","white"))(100),
    annotation_col=if (use_ann) ann_df else NA,
    annotation_row=if (use_ann) ann_df else NA,
    annotation_colors=if (use_ann) ann_colors else list(),
    display_numbers=TRUE, number_format="%.3f", fontsize_number=9,
    main="Sample-sample Pearson correlation"
  )
} else {
  cat("Correlation heatmap not available
")
}
```

```{r rna-landscape-data, include=FALSE}
# ── Data prep for RNA biotype composition plots ───────────────────────────────
classify_bt <- function(gt) case_when(
  gt=="protein_coding"                               ~ "Protein-coding",
  gt=="lncRNA"                                       ~ "lncRNA",
  grepl("pseudogene",gt)                             ~ "Pseudogene",
  gt %in% c("miRNA","snRNA","snoRNA","scaRNA","rRNA")~ "Small RNA",
  gt=="misc_RNA"                                     ~ "misc_RNA",
  gt=="TEC"                                          ~ "TEC",
  grepl("^IG_|^TR_", gt)                             ~ "IG/TR genes",
  TRUE                                               ~ "Unannotated"
)
classify_macro <- function(fid) case_when(
  grepl("^Alu|^MIR|SINE",    fid, ignore.case=TRUE) ~ "SINE (Alu/MIR)",
  grepl("^L1|^L2|^CR1|LINE", fid, ignore.case=TRUE) ~ "LINE (L1/L2)",
  grepl("^LTR|^MLT|^THE|^MER[0-9]|^HERV|^ERV|LTR",
        fid, ignore.case=TRUE)                       ~ "LTR/ERV",
  grepl("^Tigger|^Charlie|^hAT|^Mariner|^MER[A-Z]|DNA",
        fid, ignore.case=TRUE)                       ~ "DNA transposon",
  grepl("^SVA", fid, ignore.case=TRUE)               ~ "SVA",
  TRUE                                               ~ "Other TE"
)

rna_plot_data <- NULL
if (!is.null(norm_counts) && !is.null(gene_map) && length(conditions)>0) {
  cat_map_vec <- setNames(classify_bt(gene_map$gene_type), gene_map$gene_id)
  common_g    <- intersect(rownames(norm_counts), names(cat_map_vec))
  sids        <- intersect(colnames(norm_counts), names(conditions))

  make_pct_summ <- function(rows_list) {
    bind_rows(rows_list) |>
      pivot_longer(-category, names_to="sample_id", values_to="total") |>
      filter(sample_id %in% names(conditions)) |>
      group_by(sample_id) |> mutate(pct=total/sum(total)*100) |> ungroup() |>
      mutate(condition=conditions[sample_id]) |>
      group_by(category, condition) |>
      summarise(mean_pct=mean(pct), sd_pct=sd(pct), .groups="drop")
  }

  bt_totals <- norm_counts[common_g, sids, drop=FALSE] |>
    as.data.frame() |> tibble::rownames_to_column("gene_id") |>
    mutate(cat=cat_map_vec[gene_id]) |> filter(!is.na(cat)) |>
    group_by(cat) |> summarise(across(all_of(sids), sum), .groups="drop") |>
    rename(category=cat)

  rs_vec <- setNames(rep(0.0,length(sids)), sids)
  for (d in list(te_counts, sat_counts)) {
    if (!is.null(d)) {
      nc <- sapply(d,is.numeric); sc <- intersect(colnames(d)[nc],sids)
      if (length(sc)>0) rs_vec[sc] <- rs_vec[sc] + colSums(d[,sc,drop=FALSE])
    }
  }
  rs_agg <- data.frame(category="RS (TE+Satellite)", as.data.frame(t(rs_vec)), check.names=FALSE)

  # Microbial reads from M20 (Kraken2 classified, non-human)
  # Use meta_summary: total classified reads minus Homo sapiens
  micro_agg <- NULL
  if (!is.null(meta_summary) && "total_reads" %in% colnames(meta_summary)) {
    micro_vec <- setNames(rep(0.0, length(sids)), sids)
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(meta_summary))) {
      sid <- meta_summary$sample_id[i]
      if (sid %in% sids) {
        # Microbial = classified reads (already excludes unclassified)
        # We use classified count as proxy for microbial signal
        # (Homo sapiens in this context = reads mapping back to human from unmapped)
        micro_vec[sid] <- as.numeric(meta_summary$classified[i])
      }
    }
    if (sum(micro_vec) > 0)
      micro_agg <- data.frame(category="Microbial",
                               as.data.frame(t(micro_vec)), check.names=FALSE)
  }

  circ_agg <- NULL
  if (!is.null(circ_counts)) {
    nc <- sapply(circ_counts,is.numeric); sc <- intersect(colnames(circ_counts)[nc],sids)
    if (length(sc)>0)
      circ_agg <- data.frame(category="circRNA",
                              as.data.frame(t(colSums(circ_counts[,sc,drop=FALSE]))), check.names=FALSE)
  }

  pct_agg <- make_pct_summ(c(
    split(bt_totals, bt_totals$category) |>
      lapply(function(x){x$category<-x$category[1];x}),
    list(rs_agg, circ_agg, micro_agg)
  ))
  cat_ord_a <- c("Protein-coding","lncRNA","Pseudogene","Small RNA",
                 "misc_RNA","TEC","IG/TR genes","Unannotated","Microbial",
                 "RS (TE+Satellite)","circRNA")
  pct_agg$category <- factor(pct_agg$category,
    levels=rev(cat_ord_a[cat_ord_a %in% pct_agg$category]))

  # Detail rows (no protein-coding)
  detail_rows <- list()
  for (cat_nm in c("lncRNA","Pseudogene","Small RNA","misc_RNA","TEC","IG/TR genes","Unannotated")) {
    gs <- intersect(names(cat_map_vec)[cat_map_vec==cat_nm], rownames(norm_counts))
    if (length(gs)>0) {
      tv <- colSums(norm_counts[gs, sids, drop=FALSE])
      detail_rows[[cat_nm]] <- data.frame(category=cat_nm, as.data.frame(t(tv)), check.names=FALSE)
    }
  }
  if (!is.null(te_counts)) {
    nc <- sapply(te_counts,is.numeric); sc <- intersect(colnames(te_counts)[nc],sids)
    fids <- te_counts[,1]
    for (mac in unique(classify_macro(fids))) {
      sel <- classify_macro(fids)==mac
      if (any(sel)&&length(sc)>0) {
        tv <- colSums(te_counts[sel,sc,drop=FALSE])
        detail_rows[[mac]] <- data.frame(category=mac, as.data.frame(t(tv)), check.names=FALSE)
      }
    }
  }
  if (!is.null(sat_counts)) {
    nc <- sapply(sat_counts,is.numeric); sc <- intersect(colnames(sat_counts)[nc],sids)
    if (length(sc)>0) {
      tv <- colSums(sat_counts[,sc,drop=FALSE])
      detail_rows[["Satellite"]] <- data.frame(category="Satellite", as.data.frame(t(tv)), check.names=FALSE)
    }
  }
  if (!is.null(circ_counts)) {
    nc <- sapply(circ_counts,is.numeric); sc <- intersect(colnames(circ_counts)[nc],sids)
    if (length(sc)>0) {
      tv <- colSums(circ_counts[,sc,drop=FALSE])
      detail_rows[["circRNA"]] <- data.frame(category="circRNA", as.data.frame(t(tv)), check.names=FALSE)
    }
  }
  pct_det <- make_pct_summ(detail_rows)
  cat_ord_b <- pct_det |> group_by(category) |>
    summarise(m=mean(mean_pct)) |> arrange(desc(m)) |> pull(category)
  pct_det$category <- factor(pct_det$category, levels=rev(cat_ord_b))

  rna_plot_data <- list(pct_agg=pct_agg, pct_det=pct_det)
}

make_rna_panel <- function(df, log_scale, fmt, title, y_label) {
  max_y <- max(df$mean_pct + df$sd_pct, na.rm=TRUE)
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x=category, y=pmax(mean_pct,1e-6), fill=condition)) +
    geom_col(position=position_dodge(0.8), width=0.7) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin=pmax(mean_pct-sd_pct,1e-6), ymax=pmax(mean_pct+sd_pct,1e-6)),
      position=position_dodge(0.8), width=0.3, linewidth=0.4) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_manual(values=col_cond) +
    labs(title=title, x=NULL, y=y_label, fill=NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size=11) + theme(legend.position="top")
  if (log_scale) {
    p + scale_y_log10(
          breaks=c(1e-5,1e-4,1e-3,0.01,0.1,1,10,100),
          labels=c("0.00001%","0.0001%","0.001%","0.01%","0.1%","1%","10%","100%"),
          expand=expansion(mult=c(0,0.55))) +
      geom_text(aes(y=pmax(mean_pct+sd_pct,1e-5)*2,
                    label=sprintf(fmt, mean_pct)),
                position=position_dodge(0.8), hjust=0, size=3.2)
  } else {
    p + scale_y_continuous(
          labels=function(x) paste0(x,"%"),
          expand=expansion(mult=c(0,0.45))) +
      geom_text(aes(y=pmax(mean_pct+sd_pct,mean_pct*1.02) + max_y*0.02,
                    label=sprintf(fmt, mean_pct)),
                position=position_dodge(0.8), hjust=0, size=3.2)
  }
}

# Differential Expression — Canonical Genes

## Summary

```{r de-summary}
if (!is.null(de_genes)) {
  n_up   <- sum(!is.na(de_genes$padj) & de_genes$padj<padj_thr &
                de_genes$log2FoldChange > lfc_thr)
  n_down <- sum(!is.na(de_genes$padj) & de_genes$padj<padj_thr &
                de_genes$log2FoldChange < -lfc_thr)
  cat(sprintf(
    "Tested: **%s** genes  |  Up: **%d**  |  Down: **%d**  |  Not significant: **%d**\n\n",
    format(nrow(de_genes),big.mark=","), n_up, n_down,
    nrow(de_genes)-n_up-n_down))
}
```

## Volcano Plot

```{r volcano, fig.cap="Volcano plot of canonical gene differential expression (DESeq2). Each point is one gene. LFC values are ashr-shrunken. Top differentially expressed genes (by |LFC| × -log10(padj)) are labelled with their gene symbol. Dashed lines: LFC and padj thresholds."}
if (!is.null(de_genes) && nrow(de_genes)>0) {
  de_plot <- de_genes |>
    filter(!is.na(padj), !is.na(log2FoldChange)) |>
    mutate(
      neg_lp  = pmin(-log10(padj + 1e-300), 50),
      lfc_cap = pmax(pmin(log2FoldChange, 15), -15),
      status  = case_when(
        padj < padj_thr & log2FoldChange >  lfc_thr ~ "Up",
        padj < padj_thr & log2FoldChange < -lfc_thr ~ "Down",
        TRUE ~ "NS"
      ),
      gene_name_label = gene_names[gene_id],
      label_score = abs(log2FoldChange) * neg_lp
    )

  # Top genes to label
  top_label <- de_plot |>
    filter(status != "NS") |>
    arrange(desc(label_score)) |>
    head(15)
  if (nrow(top_label)==0) {
    top_label <- de_plot |> arrange(desc(label_score)) |> head(15)
  }

  ggplot(de_plot, aes(x=lfc_cap, y=neg_lp, color=status)) +
    geom_point(alpha=0.35, size=0.7) +
    geom_vline(xintercept=c(-lfc_thr, lfc_thr),
               linetype="dashed", color="grey30", linewidth=0.4) +
    geom_hline(yintercept=-log10(padj_thr),
               linetype="dashed", color="grey30", linewidth=0.4) +
    geom_label_repel(data=top_label,
                     aes(label=ifelse(!is.na(gene_name_label) &
                                        gene_name_label!="",
                                      gene_name_label, gene_id)),
                     size=2.8, max.overlaps=20,
                     box.padding=0.3, min.segment.length=0.2,
                     show.legend=FALSE) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values=c("Up"=col_up,"Down"=col_down,"NS"=col_ns),
      guide=guide_legend(override.aes=list(size=2.5,alpha=1))) +
    labs(title=sprintf("Volcano — %s vs %s", p$treatment, p$control),
         x="log2 Fold Change (ashr-shrunken, capped ±15)",
         y="-log10(BH-adjusted p-value, capped at 50)",
         color=NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size=12) +
    theme(legend.position="top")
}
```

## DE Genes Heatmap

```{r de-heatmap, fig.height=8, fig.width=7, fig.cap="Heatmap of top 50 differentially expressed genes (z-score of log2 normalised counts). Red = upregulated in treatment; blue = downregulated. Hierarchical clustering reveals co-regulated gene groups."}
if (!is.null(de_genes) && !is.null(norm_counts)) {
  top_de <- de_genes |>
    filter(!is.na(padj), padj < 0.05, abs(log2FoldChange) > 1) |>
    arrange(padj, desc(abs(log2FoldChange))) |>
    head(50)

  if (nrow(top_de) < 3) {
    cat(sprintf("Only %d significant DE genes — heatmap requires at least 3.
",
                nrow(top_de)))
    cat("With full-depth data, this section will show a z-score heatmap of top 50 DE genes.
")
  } else {
    gid_col  <- if ("gene_id" %in% colnames(top_de)) "gene_id" else colnames(top_de)[ncol(top_de)]
    gids     <- top_de[[gid_col]]
    nc_log   <- log2(as.matrix(norm_counts) + 1)
    common_g <- intersect(gids, rownames(nc_log))
    mat_z    <- t(scale(t(nc_log[common_g,,drop=FALSE])))
    rownames(mat_z) <- label_gene(rownames(mat_z))

    ann_col <- data.frame(Condition=conditions[colnames(mat_z)], row.names=colnames(mat_z))
    pheatmap::pheatmap(
      mat_z,
      color=colorRampPalette(c("#2980B9","white","#E74C3C"))(100),
      annotation_col=ann_col,
      annotation_colors=list(Condition=col_cond[unique(ann_col$Condition)]),
      main=sprintf("Top %d DE genes (z-score)", nrow(mat_z)),
      fontsize_row=max(5, 10 - nrow(mat_z)/10)
    )
  }
}

# Differential Expression — Repetitive Sequences

> **Terminology:** "Repetitive Sequences" (RS) refers to all repeat-derived transcripts quantified by MOSAIC: **Transposable Elements** (TE: LINEs, SINEs, LTR retrotransposons/ERVs, DNA transposons, SVA) and **Satellite sequences** (tandem repeats). Quantification uses DFAM 3.9 consensus pseudochromosomes (Bowtie2) for family-level counts, and RepeatMasker hg38 coordinates (TEtranscripts, pysam) for locus-level analysis.

## Top Expressed TE Families

```{r te-top, fig.height=7, fig.cap="Top expressed TE families ordered by total fragment count (all samples, highest first). Left: combined across all samples. Right: mean fragment counts per condition (mean +/- SD), same family order. Fragment counts: deduplicated junction reads mapped to DFAM 3.9 consensus pseudochromosomes (Bowtie2 --very-sensitive-local)."}
if (!is.null(te_counts)) {
  num_cols <- sapply(te_counts, is.numeric)
  fam_ids  <- te_counts[, 1]
  te_mat   <- as.matrix(te_counts[, num_cols, drop=FALSE])

  top_te <- data.frame(family_id=fam_ids, total=rowSums(te_mat)) |>
    arrange(desc(total))
  top30  <- top_te |> head(30)
  fam_lev <- rev(top30$family_id)  # factor levels for correct order

  p_all <- ggplot(top30, aes(x=factor(family_id, levels=fam_lev), y=total)) +
    geom_col(fill="#8E44AD", alpha=0.85) + coord_flip() +
    scale_y_continuous(labels=comma) +
    labs(title="All samples combined", x=NULL, y="Total fragment counts") +
    theme_minimal(base_size=9)

  if (length(conditions)>0) {
    sids_te <- intersect(colnames(te_mat), names(conditions))
    te_long <- data.frame(family_id=fam_ids, te_counts[, sids_te, drop=FALSE], check.names=FALSE) |>
      pivot_longer(-family_id, names_to="sample_id", values_to="count") |>
      mutate(condition=conditions[sample_id]) |>
      filter(family_id %in% top30$family_id)

    te_cond <- te_long |> group_by(family_id, condition) |>
      summarise(mean_c=mean(count), sd_c=sd(count), .groups="drop") |>
      mutate(family_id=factor(family_id, levels=fam_lev))

    p_cond <- ggplot(te_cond, aes(x=family_id, y=mean_c+1, fill=condition)) +
      geom_col(position=position_dodge(width=0.8), width=0.7) +
      geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=pmax(mean_c-sd_c,0)+1, ymax=mean_c+sd_c+1),
                    position=position_dodge(width=0.8), width=0.3, linewidth=0.4) +
      coord_flip() + scale_y_log10(labels=comma) +
      scale_fill_manual(values=col_cond) +
      labs(title="Top 30 TE families — mean +/- SD per condition", x=NULL,
           y="Mean counts+1 (log10)", fill=NULL) +
      theme_minimal(base_size=9) + theme(legend.position="top")

    print(p_cond)
  } else {
    print(p_all)
  }
}

## TE Expression per Sample and Condition

```{r te-by-condition, fig.height=7, fig.width=11, fig.cap="Top 20 expressed TE families. Left: individual sample counts (jittered points) with condition colour — shows replicate spread. Right: mean ± SD per condition. Log10 scale. Family order by total expression (highest at top)."}
if (!is.null(te_counts) && length(conditions)>0) {
  num_cols <- sapply(te_counts, is.numeric)
  fam_ids  <- te_counts[, 1]
  sids_te  <- intersect(colnames(te_counts)[num_cols], names(conditions))

  te_long <- data.frame(family_id=fam_ids,
                         te_counts[, sids_te, drop=FALSE], check.names=FALSE) |>
    pivot_longer(-family_id, names_to="sample_id", values_to="count") |>
    mutate(condition=conditions[sample_id]) |>
    filter(!is.na(condition))

  top20_fam <- te_long |>
    group_by(family_id) |> summarise(tot=sum(count)) |>
    slice_max(tot, n=20) |> arrange(desc(tot)) |> pull(family_id)

  te20 <- te_long |> filter(family_id %in% top20_fam) |>
    mutate(family_id=factor(family_id, levels=rev(top20_fam)))

  # Left: per-sample jitter plot (replicate spread)
  p1 <- ggplot(te20, aes(x=family_id, y=count+1, color=condition)) +
    geom_jitter(position=position_jitterdodge(jitter.width=0.2, dodge.width=0.6),
                size=2.5, alpha=0.85) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_y_log10(labels=comma) +
    scale_color_manual(values=col_cond) +
    labs(title="Per sample (replicates)", x=NULL, y="Counts+1 (log10)", color=NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size=8.5) +
    theme(legend.position="top")

  # Right: mean ± SD
  te20_summ <- te20 |>
    group_by(family_id, condition) |>
    summarise(mean_c=mean(count), sd_c=sd(count), .groups="drop")

  p2 <- ggplot(te20_summ, aes(x=family_id, y=mean_c+1, fill=condition)) +
    geom_col(position=position_dodge(width=0.8), width=0.7) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=pmax(mean_c-sd_c,0)+1, ymax=mean_c+sd_c+1),
                  position=position_dodge(width=0.8), width=0.3, linewidth=0.5) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_y_log10(labels=comma) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=col_cond) +
    labs(title="Mean ± SD per condition", x=NULL,
         y="Mean counts+1 (log10)", fill=NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size=8.5) +
    theme(legend.position="top")

  grid.arrange(p1, p2, ncol=2)
}
```

## RS Expression by Macrocategory

```{r te-macro, fig.cap="Repetitive sequence (RS) expression aggregated by macrocategory, per condition. Mean ± SD fragment counts per condition. Numbers above bars: distinct families detected. Macrocategory assignment uses DFAM family name heuristics: SINE (Alu, MIR), LINE (L1, L2, CR1), LTR/ERV (HERV, MLT, THE, MER[0-9]), DNA transposon (Tigger, Charlie, hAT, Mariner), SVA (SINE-VNTR-Alu), Satellite (from separate pseudochromosome index). Note: ERV and HERV elements are a subset of the LTR/ERV category."}
if (!is.null(te_counts) && length(conditions)>0) {
  num_cols <- sapply(te_counts, is.numeric)
  fam_ids  <- te_counts[, 1]
  sids_te  <- intersect(colnames(te_counts)[num_cols], names(conditions))

  te_macro_df <- data.frame(family_id=fam_ids,
                          macro=classify_macro(fam_ids),
                          te_counts[, sids_te, drop=FALSE], check.names=FALSE) |>
    pivot_longer(-c(family_id, macro), names_to="sample_id", values_to="count") |>
    mutate(condition=conditions[sample_id]) |>
    filter(!is.na(condition))

  # Add satellites (sat_counts has row.names=1 so family IDs are in rownames)
  if (!is.null(sat_counts)) {
    sat_num <- sapply(sat_counts, is.numeric)
    sat_sids <- intersect(colnames(sat_counts)[sat_num], names(conditions))
    sat_macro_tmp <- data.frame(family_id=rownames(sat_counts), macro="Satellite",
                             sat_counts[, sat_sids, drop=FALSE], check.names=FALSE) |>
      pivot_longer(-c(family_id, macro), names_to="sample_id", values_to="count") |>
      mutate(condition=conditions[sample_id]) |>
      filter(!is.na(condition))
    te_macro_df <- bind_rows(te_macro_df, sat_macro_tmp)
  }

  # Per-sample totals (for Wilcoxon)
  macro_per_sample <- te_macro_df |>
    group_by(macro, condition, sample_id) |>
    summarise(s_total=sum(count), n_fam=n_distinct(family_id), .groups="drop")

  macro_summ <- macro_per_sample |>
    group_by(macro, condition) |>
    summarise(mean_total=mean(s_total), sd_total=sd(s_total),
              n_fam=mean(n_fam), .groups="drop")

  # Wilcoxon test per macro (two-condition comparison)
  conds2 <- unique(macro_per_sample$condition)
  wilcox_labels <- if (length(conds2) == 2) {
    do.call(rbind, lapply(unique(macro_per_sample$macro), function(m) {
      d <- macro_per_sample[macro_per_sample$macro == m, ]
      g1 <- d$s_total[d$condition == conds2[1]]
      g2 <- d$s_total[d$condition == conds2[2]]
      pval <- tryCatch(wilcox.test(g1, g2, exact=FALSE)$p.value, error=function(e) NA)
      ymax <- max(macro_summ$mean_total[macro_summ$macro == m] +
                  macro_summ$sd_total[macro_summ$macro == m], na.rm=TRUE)
      sig_label <- ifelse(is.na(pval), "",
                   ifelse(pval < 0.001, "***",
                   ifelse(pval < 0.01,  "**",
                   ifelse(pval < 0.05,  "*", sprintf("p=%.2f", pval)))))
      data.frame(macro=m, y=ymax*1.28, label=sig_label, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
    }))
  } else NULL

  # n= label positioned just above each bar's error bar (per-macro, lower than p-value)
  n_label <- macro_summ |> group_by(macro) |>
    summarise(n_fam=round(mean(n_fam)), y=max(mean_total+sd_total, na.rm=TRUE)*1.05, .groups="drop")

  p_macro <- ggplot(macro_summ,
         aes(x=reorder(macro,-mean_total), y=mean_total, fill=condition)) +
    geom_col(position=position_dodge(width=0.8), width=0.7) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=pmax(mean_total-sd_total,0),
                      ymax=mean_total+sd_total),
                  position=position_dodge(width=0.8),
                  width=0.3, linewidth=0.5) +
    geom_text(data=n_label,
              aes(x=reorder(macro,-y), y=y,
                  label=paste0("n=",n_fam), fill=NULL),
              vjust=0, size=2.8, color="grey30", inherit.aes=FALSE)

  if (!is.null(wilcox_labels) && any(nzchar(wilcox_labels$label))) {
    p_macro <- p_macro +
      geom_text(data=wilcox_labels,
                aes(x=macro, y=y, label=label, fill=NULL),
                vjust=0, size=3.5, color="#C0392B", fontface="bold",
                inherit.aes=FALSE)
  }

  p_macro +
    scale_y_continuous(labels=comma, expand=expansion(mult=c(0,0.25))) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=col_cond) +
    labs(title="RS expression by macrocategory — mean ± SD per condition",
         subtitle=sprintf("Wilcoxon test (n=3 per group): * p<0.05, ** p<0.01, *** p<0.001. Numbers = mean distinct families.", max(nchar(""))),
         x=NULL, y="Total fragment counts (mean across samples)",
         fill="Condition") +
    theme_minimal(base_size=11) +
    theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=25,hjust=1))
}
```

```{r te-de-volcano, fig.height=5, fig.width=8, fig.cap="Volcano plot of TE family differential expression. X-axis: shrunk log2FC (ashr). Y-axis: -log10(BH-adjusted p-value). Red = upregulated in treatment; blue = downregulated. Grey = not significant. Families with |LFC|>1 and padj<0.05 labelled."}
if (!is.null(te_de) && nrow(te_de) > 0) {
  lfc_col <- if ("log2FoldChange_shrunk" %in% colnames(te_de)) "log2FoldChange_shrunk" else "log2FoldChange"
  all_padj_eq <- length(unique(na.omit(te_de$padj))) <= 2
  te_vol <- te_de |>
    filter(!is.na(padj), !is.na(.data[[lfc_col]])) |>
    mutate(
      lfc  = .data[[lfc_col]],
      neglog10p = -log10(pmax(padj, 1e-300)),
      sig  = !all_padj_eq & padj < padj_thr & abs(lfc) > lfc_thr,
      col  = case_when(
        sig & lfc > 0 ~ paste0("UP in ", p$treatment),
        sig & lfc < 0 ~ paste0("DOWN in ", p$treatment),
        TRUE           ~ "NS"
      ),
      label = ifelse(sig, family_id, NA_character_)
    )
  ggplot(te_vol, aes(x=lfc, y=neglog10p, color=col, label=label)) +
    geom_point(alpha=0.7, size=2) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(na.rm=TRUE, size=3, max.overlaps=15) +
    geom_vline(xintercept=c(-lfc_thr, lfc_thr), linetype="dashed", color="grey60") +
    geom_hline(yintercept=-log10(padj_thr), linetype="dashed", color="grey60") +
    scale_color_manual(
      values=setNames(c("#E74C3C","#3498DB","#BDC3C7"),
                      c(paste0("UP in ",p$treatment),
                        paste0("DOWN in ",p$treatment),"NS")),
      name=NULL) +
    labs(title=sprintf("TE families: %s vs %s", p$treatment, p$control),
         subtitle=if(all_padj_eq) "All padj identical (n=3/group, BH correction) — points coloured by pvalue instead" else
                  sprintf("%d significant (padj<%.2f, |LFC|>%.1f)", sum(te_vol$sig), padj_thr, lfc_thr),
         x=sprintf("log2FC (shrunk ashr) — %s / %s", p$treatment, p$control),
         y="-log10(padj)") +
    theme_minimal(base_size=12)
} else cat("TE DE data not available.\n")

## Satellite Repeat Differential Expression

Satellite repeats (pericentromeric, centromeric, telomeric) are quantified via pseudochromosome alignment (Bowtie2) to DFAM 3.9 satellite consensus sequences. They are analysed separately from TE families because they require independent normalisation and have distinct biological roles — particularly relevant for chromatin-associated RNA studies where satellite enrichment reflects heterochromatin dynamics.

```{r sat-volcano, fig.height=5, fig.width=8, fig.cap="Volcano plot of satellite repeat families. X-axis: shrunk log2FC (ashr). Y-axis: -log10(BH-adjusted p-value). Red = significantly upregulated in treatment; blue = downregulated. Grey = not significant. Families with |LFC|>1 and padj<0.05 labelled."}
if (!is.null(sat_de) && nrow(sat_de) > 0) {
  all_padj_eq_sat <- length(unique(na.omit(sat_de$padj))) <= 2
  lfc_col <- if ("log2FoldChange_shrunk" %in% colnames(sat_de)) "log2FoldChange_shrunk" else "log2FoldChange"
  pval_col <- if (all_padj_eq_sat) "pvalue" else "padj"
  sat_de |>
    filter(!is.na(!!sym(lfc_col)), !is.na(!!sym(pval_col))) |>
    mutate(
      lfc   = !!sym(lfc_col),
      pval  = !!sym(pval_col),
      negLP = pmin(-log10(pval + 1e-300), 50),
      sig   = !is.na(padj) & padj < padj_thr & abs(lfc) > lfc_thr,
      dir   = case_when(
        sig & lfc > 0 ~ paste0("Up in ", p$treatment),
        sig & lfc < 0 ~ paste0("Down in ", p$treatment),
        TRUE ~ "n.s."
      ),
      label = ifelse(sig, family_id, NA_character_)
    ) |>
    ggplot(aes(x=lfc, y=negLP, color=dir, label=label)) +
    geom_point(alpha=0.8, size=2.5) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(size=3, max.overlaps=20, show.legend=FALSE) +
    geom_hline(yintercept=-log10(padj_thr), linetype="dashed", color="grey40") +
    geom_vline(xintercept=c(-lfc_thr, lfc_thr), linetype="dashed", color="grey40") +
    scale_color_manual(values=c(
      setNames(col_up, paste0("Up in ", p$treatment)),
      setNames(col_down, paste0("Down in ", p$treatment)),
      "n.s."=col_ns), name=NULL) +
    labs(title=sprintf("Satellite DE — %s vs %s", p$treatment, p$control),
         x=sprintf("log2FC (%s / %s)", p$treatment, p$control),
         y=if(all_padj_eq_sat) "-log10(p-value)" else "-log10(padj)") +
    theme_minimal(base_size=12) + theme(legend.position="top")
} else cat("Satellite DE data not available.\n")

### Satellite DE — Wilcoxon per Family

> DESeq2 BH correction with n=3 per group and 35 families collapses all padj=1 (insufficient power). Wilcoxon rank-sum test applied per family without multiple-testing correction gives nominal p-values useful for ranking. Use for exploratory ranking only.

```{r sat-wilcox-per-family, fig.height=6, fig.width=10, fig.cap="Satellite family Wilcoxon test (nominal p-value, uncorrected). Red = higher in treatment; blue = lower in treatment. Point size = baseMean. Dashed line = p=0.05."}
if (!is.null(sat_counts) && !is.null(coldata_all) && nrow(sat_counts) > 0) {
  treat_sids   <- coldata_all$sample_id[coldata_all$condition == p$treatment]
  control_sids <- coldata_all$sample_id[coldata_all$condition == p$control]
  all_sids     <- c(treat_sids, control_sids)
  # Keep only columns that exist in sat_counts
  treat_sids   <- treat_sids[treat_sids %in% colnames(sat_counts)]
  control_sids <- control_sids[control_sids %in% colnames(sat_counts)]

  if (length(treat_sids) >= 2 && length(control_sids) >= 2) {
    wilcox_res <- lapply(rownames(sat_counts), function(fam) {
      x <- as.numeric(sat_counts[fam, treat_sids,   drop=TRUE])
      y <- as.numeric(sat_counts[fam, control_sids, drop=TRUE])
      base_mean <- mean(c(x, y))
      lfc  <- log2((mean(x) + 0.5) / (mean(y) + 0.5))
      pval <- tryCatch(wilcox.test(x, y, exact=FALSE)$p.value, error=function(e) NA_real_)
      data.frame(family_id=fam, baseMean=round(base_mean,1),
                 log2FC=round(lfc,3), wilcox_pval=round(pval,4),
                 mean_treat=round(mean(x),1), mean_ctrl=round(mean(y),1))
    })
    wilcox_df <- do.call(rbind, wilcox_res) |>
      filter(!is.na(wilcox_pval)) |>
      arrange(wilcox_pval) |>
      mutate(
        sat_macro = classify_sat_macro(family_id),
        direction = ifelse(log2FC > 0, paste0("UP in ", p$treatment),
                           paste0("DOWN in ", p$treatment)),
        # Label top 12 by p-value regardless of threshold (n=3 rarely reaches p<0.05)
        sig_label = ifelse(row_number() <= 12, family_id, NA_character_)
      )

    ggplot(wilcox_df, aes(x=log2FC, y=-log10(wilcox_pval),
                           color=direction, size=baseMean, label=sig_label)) +
      geom_point(alpha=0.8) +
      ggrepel::geom_text_repel(na.rm=TRUE, size=3, max.overlaps=20) +
      geom_hline(yintercept=-log10(0.05), linetype="dashed", color="grey50") +
      geom_vline(xintercept=0, linetype="dashed", color="grey70") +
      scale_color_manual(
        values=setNames(c("#E74C3C","#3498DB"),
                        c(paste0("UP in ",p$treatment), paste0("DOWN in ",p$treatment))),
        name=NULL) +
      scale_size_continuous(range=c(2,8), name="baseMean") +
      labs(title=sprintf("Satellite family Wilcoxon (nominal, n=%d+%d per group)",
                         length(treat_sids), length(control_sids)),
           subtitle="Uncorrected p-values — exploratory ranking only",
           x=sprintf("log2FC (%s / %s)", p$treatment, p$control),
           y="-log10(Wilcoxon p-value)") +
      theme_minimal(base_size=12)
  } else {
    cat(sprintf("Not enough samples: %d treatment, %d control\n",
                length(treat_sids), length(control_sids)))
  }
} else cat("Satellite counts or coldata not available.\n")
```

### Satellite DE — Aggregated by Macrocategory

> Per-family Wilcoxon lacks power (n=3). Aggregating counts across families within each macrocategory increases power by reducing the multiple-testing burden and summing signal across co-regulated families.

```{r sat-aggregate-macro-data, include=FALSE}
# Compute aggregated satellite data (used by table and plot chunks below)
.sat_agg_ok <- FALSE
if (!is.null(sat_counts) && !is.null(coldata_all) && nrow(sat_counts) > 0) {
  .treat_sids_agg   <- coldata_all$sample_id[coldata_all$condition == p$treatment]
  .control_sids_agg <- coldata_all$sample_id[coldata_all$condition == p$control]
  .treat_sids_agg   <- .treat_sids_agg[.treat_sids_agg %in% colnames(sat_counts)]
  .control_sids_agg <- .control_sids_agg[.control_sids_agg %in% colnames(sat_counts)]

  if (length(.treat_sids_agg) >= 2 && length(.control_sids_agg) >= 2) {
    fam_macro_agg <- classify_sat_macro(rownames(sat_counts))
    names(fam_macro_agg) <- rownames(sat_counts)

    agg_list <- lapply(unique(fam_macro_agg), function(mac) {
      fams <- names(fam_macro_agg)[fam_macro_agg == mac]
      totals <- if (length(fams) == 1) {
        as.numeric(sat_counts[fams, c(.treat_sids_agg, .control_sids_agg), drop=FALSE])
      } else {
        colSums(sat_counts[fams, c(.treat_sids_agg, .control_sids_agg), drop=FALSE])
      }
      cond <- c(rep(p$treatment, length(.treat_sids_agg)),
                rep(p$control,   length(.control_sids_agg)))
      data.frame(macro=mac, counts=totals, condition=cond)
    })
    agg_df <- do.call(rbind, agg_list)

    wilcox_mac <- agg_df |>
      group_by(macro) |>
      summarise(
        pval = tryCatch(
          wilcox.test(counts[condition==p$treatment],
                      counts[condition==p$control], exact=FALSE)$p.value,
          error=function(e) NA_real_),
        mean_treat = mean(counts[condition==p$treatment]),
        mean_ctrl  = mean(counts[condition==p$control]),
        .groups="drop"
      ) |>
      mutate(
        # Only mark significant pairs (p<0.05); leave others blank
        sig_mark  = case_when(
          is.na(pval)    ~ "",
          pval < 0.001   ~ "***",
          pval < 0.01    ~ "**",
          pval < 0.05    ~ "*",
          TRUE           ~ ""
        ),
        pval_label = ifelse(!is.na(pval), sprintf("p=%.3f", pval), "NA"),
        direction  = ifelse(mean_treat > mean_ctrl,
                            paste0("↑ ", p$treatment), paste0("↓ ", p$treatment))
      )
    .sat_agg_ok <- TRUE
  }
}
```

```{r sat-aggregate-macro-table, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
if (isTRUE(.sat_agg_ok)) {
  knitr::kable(
    wilcox_mac |>
      mutate(lfc=round(log2((mean_treat+0.5)/(mean_ctrl+0.5)),3),
             mean_treat=round(mean_treat,1), mean_ctrl=round(mean_ctrl,1),
             pval=round(pval,4)) |>
      select(macro, mean_treat, mean_ctrl, lfc, pval, sig_mark, direction) |>
      arrange(pval),
    col.names=c("Macrocategory", sprintf("Mean(%s)",p$treatment),
                sprintf("Mean(%s)",p$control), "log2FC", "Wilcoxon p", "Sig", "Direction"),
    caption="Aggregated satellite Wilcoxon by macrocategory (uncorrected). Sig: * p<0.05, ** p<0.01, *** p<0.001."
  ) |> kable_styling(bootstrap_options=c("striped","condensed"), full_width=FALSE)
} else {
  cat("Satellite counts or coldata not available / insufficient samples.\n")
}
```

```{r sat-aggregate-macro-plot, fig.height=5, fig.width=9, fig.cap="Aggregated satellite expression by macrocategory. Bar = mean total counts across samples; error bars = SEM. Only statistically significant differences (p<0.05, uncorrected Wilcoxon) are marked with asterisks above the bars."}
if (isTRUE(.sat_agg_ok)) {
  agg_df |>
    group_by(macro, condition) |>
    summarise(mean_cnt=mean(counts), sem=sd(counts)/sqrt(n()), .groups="drop") |>
    mutate(condition=factor(condition, levels=c(p$control, p$treatment))) |>
    ggplot(aes(x=macro, y=mean_cnt, fill=condition)) +
    geom_col(position="dodge") +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=mean_cnt-sem, ymax=mean_cnt+sem),
                  position=position_dodge(0.9), width=0.3) +
    # Only show label if significant
    geom_text(data=wilcox_mac |> filter(nzchar(sig_mark)),
              aes(x=macro, y=pmax(mean_treat, mean_ctrl)*1.12,
                  label=sig_mark, fill=NULL),
              size=4.5, fontface="bold", color="#C0392B", inherit.aes=FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=setNames(c("#85C1E9","#E74C3C"),
                                      c(p$control, p$treatment)), name="Condition") +
    labs(title="Satellite expression aggregated by macrocategory",
         subtitle="Mean total counts ± SEM. * p<0.05, ** p<0.01, *** p<0.001 (Wilcoxon, uncorrected)",
         x=NULL, y="Mean total fragment counts") +
    theme_minimal(base_size=12) +
    theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=25, hjust=1))
} else {
  cat("Aggregated satellite plot not available.\n")
}
```

## TE Age Analysis (M11c)

```{r te-age-landscape, fig.height=5, fig.width=10, fig.cap="TE age landscape: distribution of RepeatMasker substitution divergence per macrocategory. Low divergence = recently inserted (young/active); high divergence = ancient insertions. SVA elements show the youngest profile, consistent with ongoing retrotransposition in humans."}
if (!is.null(te_age_summary)) {
  te_age_summary |>
    mutate(macro=reorder(macro, mean_div)) |>
    ggplot(aes(x=macro, y=mean_div, fill=macro)) +
    geom_col(show.legend=FALSE, alpha=0.85) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=mean_div-sd_div, ymax=mean_div+sd_div),
                  width=0.3, linewidth=0.5) +
    geom_text(aes(label=sprintf("%.1f%%", mean_div)),
              hjust=-0.2, size=3.5) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_manual(values=col_macro) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand=expansion(mult=c(0,0.2))) +
    labs(title="Mean divergence from TE consensus sequence by macrocategory",
         subtitle="Proxy for insertion age: lower = younger/more recently active",
         x=NULL, y="Mean divergence from consensus (%)") +
    theme_minimal(base_size=12)
} else {
  cat("TE age landscape data not available (te_age_summary.tsv from M11c).\n")
  cat("M11c annotates RepeatMasker loci with substitution divergence (proxy for insertion age).\n")
  cat("Re-run M11c to generate this plot.\n")
}
```

```{r te-age-de, fig.height=6, fig.width=9, fig.cap="Correlation between TE family age (mean divergence from consensus) and differential expression (log2FC). Point size proportional to number of genomic loci. Labels indicate families with significant expression changes."}
if (!is.null(te_age_de_tbl) && nrow(te_age_de_tbl) >= 5) {
  lfc_col  <- grep("log2", colnames(te_age_de_tbl), value=TRUE)[1]
  pval_col <- if ("pvalue" %in% colnames(te_age_de_tbl)) "pvalue" else "padj"

  te_age_de_tbl |>
    rename(lfc=all_of(lfc_col), pval=all_of(pval_col)) |>
    mutate(sig=pval < 0.05,
           label=ifelse(sig & abs(lfc) > 1, family_id, NA)) |>
    ggplot(aes(x=mean_div, y=lfc, color=macro, size=n_loci)) +
    geom_point(alpha=0.7) +
    geom_hline(yintercept=0, linetype="dashed", color="grey50") +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label=label), size=2.8,
                              max.overlaps=15, show.legend=FALSE) +
    scale_color_manual(values=col_macro) +
    scale_size_continuous(range=c(2,8), name="# loci") +
    labs(title="TE age vs expression change",
         x="Mean divergence from consensus (%) — proxy for age",
         y=sprintf("log2FC (%s / %s)", p$treatment, p$control),
         color="TE class") +
    theme_minimal(base_size=12)
} else {
  cat("TE age vs DE data not available (te_age_de_table.tsv from M11c).\n")
  cat("This file is generated when M11c successfully annotates TE families with age metrics\n")
  cat("and merges them with the DE results. Re-run M11c to generate this analysis.\n")
}
```

# GO and Pathway Enrichment

> Over-Representation Analysis (ORA, clusterProfiler). Background universe for canonical genes: all expressed genes (baseMean>0). Background for TE host genes: genes with ≥1 expressed TE locus in their gene body (RepeatMasker M11 intersection — 51,934 genes), providing a TE-specific unbiased background. Multiple testing: Benjamini-Hochberg (BH). Gene set size: 10–500.

## TE Genomic Distribution

```{r te-genomic, fig.height=6, fig.width=9, fig.cap="Top 30 DE TE-host genes ranked by TE insertion density (TE loci per kb of gene body). A higher density means more TE copies are embedded within the gene relative to its length. Only genes that are both differentially expressed (padj < threshold) AND host ≥1 TE locus in RepeatMasker hg38 are included. Density normalisation corrects for gene length bias: long genes naturally accumulate more TE loci and would otherwise dominate a raw-count ranking. Colour indicates the dominant TE macrocategory (highest density) per gene."}
if (!is.null(te_host) && !is.null(de_genes)) {
  # Get DE gene IDs
  gid_col_de  <- colnames(de_genes)[ncol(de_genes)]
  de_gene_ids <- de_genes[[gid_col_de]][!is.na(de_genes$padj) &
                                         de_genes$padj < padj_thr]

  if (length(de_gene_ids) == 0) {
    de_gene_ids <- character(0)
  }

  # Join DE genes with TE host table
  te_de_host <- te_host |>
    filter(gene_id %in% de_gene_ids) |>
    mutate(
      gene_name   = gene_names[gene_id],
      label       = ifelse(!is.na(gene_name) & gene_name!="", gene_name, gene_id),
      n_te_loci   = if ("n_te_loci"    %in% colnames(te_host)) n_te_loci else
                    if ("te_count"     %in% colnames(te_host)) te_count else 1L,
      gene_len_kb = if ("gene_length"  %in% colnames(te_host)) gene_length/1000 else NA_real_,
      dominant_macro = if ("dominant_macro" %in% colnames(te_host)) dominant_macro else
                       if ("te_class" %in% colnames(te_host)) te_class else
                       if ("te_families" %in% colnames(te_host))
                         sapply(te_families, dominant_macro_from_families)
                       else "Other TE",
      te_density  = ifelse(!is.na(gene_len_kb) & gene_len_kb > 0,
                           n_te_loci / gene_len_kb, NA_real_)
    )

  if (nrow(te_de_host) == 0) {
    cat("No DE TE host genes found at current thresholds.
")
    cat(sprintf("DE genes: %d | TE host genes: %d
",
                length(de_gene_ids), nrow(te_host)))
  } else {
    # Use n_te_loci if density not available
    sort_col <- if (all(is.na(te_de_host$te_density))) "n_te_loci" else "te_density"

    top30 <- te_de_host |>
      arrange(desc(.data[[sort_col]])) |>
      head(30)

    y_lab <- if (sort_col == "te_density") "TE loci per kb of gene body" else
             "Number of TE loci"
    title_sfx <- if (sort_col == "te_density") "(density-normalised)" else
                 "(raw loci count - gene length unavailable)"

    ggplot(top30, aes(x=reorder(label, .data[[sort_col]]),
                       y=.data[[sort_col]], fill=dominant_macro)) +
      geom_col() +
      coord_flip() +
      scale_fill_manual(values=col_macro, na.value="#95A5A6",
                        name="Dominant TE") +
      labs(title=sprintf("Top 30 DE TE host genes %s", title_sfx),
           subtitle=sprintf("DE genes (padj<%.2f) with >=1 TE in gene body | %d genes total",
                            padj_thr, nrow(te_de_host)),
           x=NULL, y=y_lab) +
      theme_minimal(base_size=11)
  }
} else {
  cat("TE host gene data not available (te_host_genes.tsv from M11).
")
}
```

## TE Insertions in DE Gene Promoters and Gene Bodies (M11b/M11d)

> **Column guide for tables below:**
> - `Direction` = the condition in which the gene is upregulated (e.g. "mito-ChaRNA" means higher expression in the treatment group; "ChaRNA" means higher in control). Determined by the sign of log2FC.
> - `TE context` = whether a TE insertion is detected in the promoter (2 kb upstream TSS), gene body, both, or neither (`No TE` = no RepeatMasker locus overlaps either window — the gene is differentially expressed independently of detectable TE presence).
> - `Prom TE loci` = number of distinct RepeatMasker loci in the 2 kb promoter window.
> - `No TE` category (grey in stacked bar): DE genes where neither promoter nor gene body contains a TE insertion in RepeatMasker hg38. This does not mean the gene is TE-free genome-wide — it means no locus falls within the defined windows.

> **Lollipop plot symbols (section below):** Each gene is a dot on a stick. Dot position = log2FC (right = up in treatment). Dot size ∝ significance (larger = smaller padj). Symbol prefix in colour legend indicates TE context: `** Prom+Body` = TE in both windows; `>> Promoter` = promoter only; `>> Body` = gene body only; `-- None` = no TE in either window.

> **Promoter TE context (M11b):** Genes are annotated with TE insertions within 2 kb upstream of the TSS (bedtools intersect, RepeatMasker hg38). Gene body TE overlap from M11. Integrated view in M11d combines promoter TE, body TE, and DE status.

### Overview: Genes with Promoter TE Insertions

```{r promoter-te-summary, fig.height=5, fig.width=8, fig.cap="Number of genes with TE insertions within 2kb upstream of the TSS, by TE macrocategory. Based on bedtools intersect of GENCODE v49 promoter windows with RepeatMasker hg38 (M11b)."}
if (is.null(te_prom_summary)) {
  cat("Promoter TE summary not available (M11b produced no output).\n")
  cat("M11b computes TE insertions within 2kb upstream of each TSS using bedtools.\n")
  cat("Re-run M11b to enable this section and the downstream enrichment analyses.\n")
} else {
  te_prom_summary |>
    mutate(te_macrocategory=reorder(te_macrocategory, n_genes_with_promoter_te)) |>
    ggplot(aes(x=te_macrocategory, y=n_genes_with_promoter_te,
               fill=te_macrocategory)) +
    geom_col(show.legend=FALSE) +
    geom_text(aes(label=scales::comma(n_genes_with_promoter_te)),
              hjust=-0.1, size=3.5) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_manual(values=col_macro) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand=expansion(mult=c(0,0.15)),
                       labels=scales::comma) +
    labs(title="Genes with promoter TE insertions by macrocategory",
         subtitle=sprintf("Total: %s genes (2kb upstream TSS)",
                          scales::comma(sum(te_prom_summary$n_genes_with_promoter_te))),
         x=NULL, y="Number of genes") +
    theme_minimal(base_size=12)
}
```

### DE Genes with TE Insertions — Enrichment Analysis

```{r de-te-barplot, fig.height=5, fig.width=7, fig.cap="DE genes stratified by TE insertion context. 'Promoter TE' = TE within 2kb upstream of TSS; 'Body TE' = TE within the gene locus (start to end). Fisher's exact test p-values shown."}
if (!is.null(de_te_integrated) && nrow(de_te_integrated) > 0) {
  p_cat <- de_te_integrated |>
    count(direction, te_category) |>
    ggplot(aes(x=direction, y=n, fill=te_category)) +

      "No TE"              = "#BDC3C7"
    ), name="TE context") +
    labs(title="DE genes by TE insertion context",
         x="Direction", y="Number of DE genes") +
    theme_minimal(base_size=13)
  print(p_cat)
} else cat("DE-TE integration data not available.
")

```{r fisher-enrichment}
if (!is.null(te_enrich_fisher) && nrow(te_enrich_fisher) > 0) {
  te_enrich_fisher |>
    mutate(
      sig = ifelse(pvalue < 0.05, "yes", "no"),
      pvalue = formatC(pvalue, digits=4, format="g"),
      odds_ratio = round(odds_ratio, 2)
    ) |>
    select(Analysis=analysis, `DE with TE`=n_DE_with, `DE total`=n_DE_total,
           `BG with TE`=n_bg_with, `BG total`=n_bg_total,
           OR=odds_ratio, `p-value`=pvalue, Significant=sig) |>
    knitr::kable(caption="Fisher's exact test: TE enrichment in DE genes vs background (expressed genes, baseMean>5). OR>1 = DE genes enriched for TE insertions.",
                 align="lrrrrrrc")
} else cat("Fisher test results not available.
")
```

```{r macro-enrichment, fig.height=4.5, fig.width=7, fig.cap="Enrichment of each TE macrocategory in promoters of DE genes. Fisher's exact test (one-sided, greater). Dashed line = p=0.05; * = BH-adjusted p<0.05. With full data, significant bars indicate TE families whose presence in promoters correlates with differential expression."}
if (!is.null(macro_enrich) && nrow(macro_enrich) > 0) {
  macro_enrich |>
    mutate(
      sig = ifelse(padj < 0.05, "*", ""),
      macrocategory = reorder(macrocategory, -log10(pvalue + 1e-10))
    ) |>
    ggplot(aes(x=macrocategory, y=-log10(pvalue), fill=macrocategory)) +
    geom_col(show.legend=FALSE) +
    geom_text(aes(label=sig), vjust=-0.3, size=5) +
    geom_hline(yintercept=-log10(0.05), linetype="dashed",
               color="grey40", linewidth=0.6) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=col_macro) +
    labs(title="Promoter TE macrocategory enrichment in DE genes",
         subtitle="Fisher's exact test; dashed = p=0.05; * = BH adj p<0.05",
         x=NULL, y="-log10(p-value)") +
    theme_minimal(base_size=12) +
    theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=30, hjust=1))
} else cat("Macrocategory enrichment not available.
")
```

### Top DE Genes with TE Annotations

```{r de-te-lollipop, fig.height=9, fig.width=10, fig.cap="Top 30 DE genes ordered by log2FC. Symbol indicates TE insertion context: '** Prom+Body' = promoter AND gene body; '>> Promoter' = promoter only; '>> Body' = gene body only; '-- None' = no TE insertion detected. Point size proportional to significance (-log10 padj)."}
if (!is.null(de_te_integrated) && nrow(de_te_integrated) > 0) {
  top_de <- de_te_integrated |>
    arrange(padj, desc(abs(log2FoldChange))) |>
    head(30) |>
    mutate(
      label    = ifelse(!is.na(gene_name) & gene_name!="", gene_name, gene_id),
      te_label = case_when(
        has_prom_te & has_body_te ~ "** Prom+Body",
        has_prom_te               ~ ">> Promoter",
        has_body_te               ~ ">> Body",
        TRUE                      ~ "-- None"
      )
    )
  ggplot(top_de, aes(x=reorder(label, log2FoldChange),
                     y=log2FoldChange, color=te_label)) +
    geom_segment(aes(xend=reorder(label, log2FoldChange), yend=0),
                 linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.6) +
    geom_point(aes(size=-log10(padj + 1e-10)), alpha=0.9) +
    geom_hline(yintercept=0, linetype="dashed", color="grey50") +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_color_manual(values=c(
      "** Prom+Body" = "#8E44AD",
      ">> Promoter"  = "#3498DB",
      ">> Body"      = "#E67E22",
      "-- None"      = "#95A5A6"
    ), name="TE context") +
    scale_size_continuous(range=c(2,7), name="-log10(padj)") +
    labs(title="Top 30 DE genes - TE insertion context",
         x=NULL,
         y=sprintf("log2FC (%s / %s)", p$treatment, p$control)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size=11) +
    theme(legend.position="right")
} else cat("DE-TE lollipop data not available.
")

```{r de-te-full-table}

if (!is.null(circ_annot) && nrow(circ_annot)>0) {

    kable_styling(bootstrap_options=c("striped","hover","condensed"))
} else {

}
```

## Junction Read Counts

```{r circ-counts}
if (!is.null(circ_counts) && nrow(circ_counts)>0) {
  kable(circ_counts,
        caption="Back-splice junction read counts per circRNA locus and sample. Each value is the number of chimeric reads spanning the back-splice junction.") |>
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options=c("striped","hover","condensed"))
}
```

## Differential Expression

```{r circ-de}
if (!is.null(circ_de) && nrow(circ_de)>0) {
  circ_sig <- circ_de |>
    filter(!is.na(padj), padj<padj_thr, abs(log2FoldChange)>lfc_thr)

  show_df <- if (nrow(circ_sig)>0) {
    circ_sig |> arrange(padj)
  } else {
    circ_de |> arrange(pvalue)
  }

  cap <- if (nrow(circ_sig)>0) {
    sprintf("Significantly DE circRNA loci (padj<%.2f, |LFC|>%.1f). Wilcoxon rank-sum test with BH correction (n<3 per group). log2FoldChange = log2((mean_%s+1)/(mean_%s+1)).", padj_thr, lfc_thr, p$treatment, p$control)
  } else {
    sprintf("All tested circRNA loci (Wilcoxon rank-sum, BH correction). No loci reached significance thresholds (padj<%.2f, |LFC|>%.1f).", padj_thr, lfc_thr)
  }

  show_df |> mutate(across(where(is.numeric),~round(.,4))) |>
    kable(caption=cap) |>
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options=c("striped","hover","condensed"))
}
```

# TE Locus-Specific Analysis (M12)

## TEtranscripts

> TEtranscripts uses Expectation-Maximization to resolve multi-mapping reads between canonical gene loci and TE insertions simultaneously. The section below shows **only TE-derived features** (non-ENSG IDs). Canonical gene DE results are in Section 2.

```{r tet-results}
if (!is.null(tet_sig) && nrow(tet_sig) > 0) {
  if (!"gene_id" %in% colnames(tet_sig)) {
    tet_sig$feature_id <- rownames(tet_sig)
  } else {
    tet_sig$feature_id <- tet_sig$gene_id
  }

  # Separate TE features (non-ENSG) from canonical genes (ENSG)
  te_features <- tet_sig |>
    filter(!grepl("^ENSG", feature_id)) |>
    mutate(
      te_name   = sub(":.*", "", feature_id),
      te_family = sub("^[^:]+:([^:]+):.*", "\1", feature_id),
      te_class  = sub("^[^:]+:[^:]+:(.*)", "\1", feature_id),
      macro     = classify_macro(te_name)
    ) |>
    arrange(padj) |>
    select(TE=te_name, Family=te_family, Class=te_class, Macro=macro,
           any_of(c("baseMean","log2FoldChange","log2FoldChange_shrunk",
                    "pvalue","padj"))) |>
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 4)))

  canon_n <- sum(grepl("^ENSG", tet_sig$feature_id))
  te_n    <- nrow(te_features)

  cat(sprintf("TEtranscripts significant features: %d total (%d canonical genes, %d TE loci)
",
              nrow(tet_sig), canon_n, te_n))

  if (te_n > 0) {
    DT::datatable(
      te_features,
      caption=sprintf(
        "Significant TE-derived features from TEtranscripts (%s vs %s, padj<%.2f). %d canonical gene features excluded (see Section 2).",
        p$treatment, p$control, padj_thr, canon_n),
      options=list(pageLength=15, scrollX=TRUE,
                   dom="Bfrtip", buttons=c("csv","excel")),
      extensions="Buttons",
      rownames=FALSE
    )
  } else {
    cat("No significant TE-specific features at current thresholds.
")
    cat("(All TEtranscripts hits are canonical genes — shown in Section 2)
")
  }
} else {
  cat("**M12 (TEtranscripts) — not run for this dataset.**\n\n")
  cat("TEtranscripts v2.2.3 uses Expectation-Maximization (EM) to resolve multi-mapping reads between canonical gene loci and individual TE insertions in RepeatMasker hg38. It provides locus-level TE quantification complementary to the pseudochromosome family-level approach (Section 3).\n\n")
  cat("M12 has not been executed for this comparison. To enable this section, run M12 and regenerate the report.\n")
}
```

# De Novo Transcripts (M16 — StringTie)

> StringTie assembled transcripts de novo from STAR-aligned BAM files, then merged across samples and compared to GENCODE v49 using gffcompare. Novel transcripts were quantified with `-e -b` and tested for differential expression using DESeq2 (proxy counts from FPKM x 10).


## Assembly Summary

```{r st-summary}
if (!is.null(st_summary)) {
  knitr::kable(st_summary,
    caption="StringTie de novo assembly summary. 'Exact match' = transcripts fully matching GENCODE annotation. Novel categories: j=new junction combination, i=novel intronic, u=novel intergenic, x=antisense to reference.",
    col.names=c("Metric","Count"),
    format.args=list(big.mark=",")) |>
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options=c("striped","condensed"), full_width=FALSE)
} else cat("StringTie summary not available.
")
```

```{r st-class-codes, fig.height=5, fig.width=9, fig.cap="Distribution of gffcompare class codes. Red = novel or partially novel transcripts; blue = matching reference annotation. 'j' (new junction combination) are high-confidence novel isoforms sharing splice sites with known transcripts."}
if (!is.null(st_class_codes)) {
  st_class_codes |>
    mutate(
      label = paste0(class_code, "
", sub(" .*","",description)),
      label = reorder(label, n)
    ) |>
    ggplot(aes(x=label, y=n, fill=novel)) +
    geom_col() +
    scale_fill_manual(values=c("TRUE"="#E74C3C","FALSE"="#85C1E9"),
                      labels=c("TRUE"="Novel","FALSE"="Annotated"), name=NULL) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::comma) +
    labs(title="StringTie transcript classification (gffcompare)",
         x="Class code", y="Number of transcripts") +
    theme_minimal(base_size=12)
} else cat("Class code data not available.
")
```

## Novel Transcript DE

```{r novel-de-summary}
if (!is.null(novel_de)) {
  n_sig <- sum(!is.na(novel_de$padj) & novel_de$padj < padj_thr &
                 abs(novel_de$log2FoldChange) > lfc_thr, na.rm=TRUE)
  cat(sprintf("Novel transcripts tested: %d\n", nrow(novel_de)))
  cat(sprintf("Significant (padj<%.2f, |LFC|>%.1f): %d\n", padj_thr, lfc_thr, n_sig))
} else {
  # Explain based on StringTie assembly results
  if (!is.null(st_summary)) {
    novel_n <- tryCatch({
      novel_row <- st_summary[grepl("Novel candidates", st_summary[[1]], ignore.case=TRUE), ]
      if (nrow(novel_row) > 0) as.integer(novel_row[[2]][1]) else NA
    }, error=function(e) NA)
    if (!is.na(novel_n) && novel_n == 0) {
      cat("No novel transcripts to test: StringTie assembly found 0 novel transcript candidates.\n")
      cat("All assembled transcripts match GENCODE annotation exactly (class_code '=').\n")
      cat("This is the expected result when the reference annotation covers all detected isoforms.\n")
    } else {
      cat("Novel DE data not available (novel_transcript_DE.tsv not generated).\n")
    }
  } else {
    cat("Novel DE data not available (StringTie output or novel_transcript_DE.tsv missing).\n")
  }
}
```

```{r novel-de-volcano, fig.height=6, fig.width=9, fig.cap="Volcano plot of novel transcript differential expression. Each point is a StringTie-assembled novel transcript not matching GENCODE annotation. Red = up-regulated in treatment; blue = down-regulated. Labels show transcript IDs of most significant events."}
if (!is.null(novel_de) && nrow(novel_de) > 0) {
  novel_de |>
    filter(!is.na(padj), !is.na(log2FoldChange)) |>
    mutate(
      sig = padj < padj_thr & abs(log2FoldChange) > lfc_thr,
      col = case_when(
        sig & log2FoldChange > 0 ~ "UP",
        sig & log2FoldChange < 0 ~ "DOWN",
        TRUE ~ "NS"
      ),
      lab = ifelse(sig, t_name, NA)
    ) |>
    ggplot(aes(x=log2FoldChange, y=-log10(padj+1e-10), color=col)) +
    geom_point(alpha=0.7, size=1.8) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label=lab), size=2.5,
                              max.overlaps=15, show.legend=FALSE) +
    scale_color_manual(values=c(UP="#E74C3C",DOWN="#3498DB",NS="#BDC3C7"),
                       name=NULL) +
    geom_vline(xintercept=c(-lfc_thr, lfc_thr),
               linetype="dashed", color="grey50") +
    geom_hline(yintercept=-log10(padj_thr),
               linetype="dashed", color="grey50") +
    labs(title="Novel transcript DE - volcano",
         subtitle=sprintf("%s vs %s", p$treatment, p$control),
         x=sprintf("log2FC (%s / %s)", p$treatment, p$control),
         y="-log10(padj)") +
    theme_minimal(base_size=12)
} else cat("Novel DE data not available.
")
```

```{r novel-de-table}

# Differential Alternative Splicing (M17 — rMATS)

> rMATS quantified five classes of alternative splicing events from STAR-aligned BAM files: Skipped Exon (SE), Alternative 3'/5' Splice Site (A3SS/A5SS), Mutually Exclusive Exons (MXE), and Retained Intron (RI). deltaPSI = PSI(treatment) - PSI(control), where PSI (Percent Spliced In) ranges from 0 to 1.


## Event Summary

```{r splicing-summary, fig.height=5, fig.width=9, fig.cap="Differential alternative splicing events by type. Positive bars = increased inclusion in treatment; negative bars = decreased inclusion (increased skipping/exclusion). deltaPSI threshold: 0.1."}
if (!is.null(splicing_summary)) {
  col_event <- c(SE="#E74C3C", A3SS="#3498DB", A5SS="#2ECC71",
                 MXE="#F39C12", RI="#9B59B6")
  label_event <- c(SE="Skipped Exon", A3SS="Alt 3' SS",
                   A5SS="Alt 5' SS", MXE="Mut. Excl.", RI="Ret. Intron")

  splicing_summary |>
    select(event_type, sig_enhanced, sig_skipped) |>
    pivot_longer(-event_type, names_to="direction", values_to="n") |>
    mutate(
      n = ifelse(direction=="sig_skipped", -n, n),
      direction = ifelse(direction=="sig_enhanced",
                         paste0("Increased in ", p$treatment),
                         paste0("Decreased in ", p$treatment))
    ) |>
    ggplot(aes(x=event_type, y=n, fill=direction)) +
    geom_col() +
    geom_hline(yintercept=0, linewidth=0.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=c("#E74C3C","#3498DB"), name=NULL) +
    labs(title="Differential splicing events by type",
         subtitle=sprintf("%s vs %s | |dPSI|>0.1", p$treatment, p$control),
         x="Event type", y="Significant events") +
    theme_minimal(base_size=13)
} else cat("Splicing summary not available.
")
```

```{r splicing-summary-table}
if (!is.null(splicing_summary)) {
  splicing_summary |>
    mutate(pct_sig=round(100*sig_events/total_events, 1)) |>
    select(Type=event_type, Description=description,
           Total=total_events, Significant=sig_events,
           `% sig`=pct_sig,
           `Increased`=sig_enhanced, `Decreased`=sig_skipped,
           `Mean |dPSI|`=mean_dpsi) |>
    knitr::kable(caption="Summary of differential splicing events per type.") |>
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options=c("striped","condensed"), full_width=FALSE)
} else cat("Splicing summary not available.
")
```

```{r wgcna-trait-cor, fig.height=5, fig.width=8, fig.cap="WGCNA module-condition correlation. * = p<0.05. Positive = higher in treatment condition."}
if (!is.null(wgcna_mt_cor) && nrow(wgcna_mt_cor) > 0 &&
    !all(is.na(wgcna_mt_cor$correlation))) {
  p1 <- wgcna_mt_cor |>
    arrange(pvalue) |>
    mutate(sig=ifelse(!is.na(pvalue) & pvalue<0.05,"*",""),
           module=reorder(module, ifelse(is.na(correlation),0,correlation))) |>
    ggplot(aes(x=module, y=correlation, fill=correlation>0)) +
    geom_col() +
    geom_text(aes(y=ifelse(correlation>0, correlation+0.05, correlation-0.05),
                  label=sig), size=5) +
    geom_hline(yintercept=0, linewidth=0.5) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_manual(values=c("TRUE"="#E74C3C","FALSE"="#3498DB"), name=NULL,
                      labels=c("TRUE"=paste0("Higher in ",p$treatment),
                               "FALSE"=paste0("Higher in ",p$control))) +
    labs(title="Module-condition correlation",
         subtitle="* = p<0.05", x="Module", y="Pearson r") +
    theme_minimal(base_size=12)
  print(p1)
  wgcna_mt_cor |>
    arrange(pvalue) |>
    mutate(sig=ifelse(pvalue<0.05,"*",""),
           across(c(correlation,pvalue), ~round(.,4))) |>
    knitr::kable(caption="WGCNA module-condition correlation table.") |>
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options=c("striped","condensed"), full_width=FALSE)
} else if (!is.null(wgcna_mt_cor) && all(is.na(wgcna_mt_cor$correlation))) {
  cat(sprintf(paste0(
    "WGCNA module-trait correlations are all NA (%d modules).\n",
    "This is expected with n=3 samples per condition: WGCNA requires ≥6-10 samples ",
    "per group for reliable correlation estimates. The modules are detected but ",
    "cannot be statistically correlated to condition with the current sample size.\n"),
    nrow(wgcna_mt_cor)))
  wgcna_mt_cor |>
    knitr::kable(caption="WGCNA modules (correlations not computable with n=3 per group).") |>
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options=c("striped","condensed"), full_width=FALSE)
} else cat("Module-trait correlation not available.\n")

# RNA Editing (M19 — JACUSA2)

> RNA editing detected via JACUSA2 call-2 comparing BAM files between conditions. JACUSA2 detects all base-substitution mismatches at each site; M19 extracts and reports both **A-to-I (A→G)** editing (ADAR enzymes) and all other mismatch types including **C-to-U (C→T)** (APOBEC enzymes).


## Editing Summary

```{r editing-summary}
if (!is.null(editing_summary) && nrow(editing_summary) > 0) {
  editing_summary |>
    mutate(metric = gsub("_normal\\b", paste0("_", p$control),   metric),
           metric = gsub("_tumor\\b",  paste0("_", p$treatment), metric),
           metric = gsub("\\bnormal\\b", p$control,   metric),
           metric = gsub("\\btumor\\b",  p$treatment, metric)) |>
    knitr::kable(col.names=c("Metric","Value"),
      caption=sprintf("RNA A-to-I editing summary (JACUSA2). EF = editing frequency (edited reads / total reads). dEF = EF(%s) - EF(%s).", p$treatment, p$control)) |>
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options=c("striped","condensed"), full_width=FALSE)
} else cat("RNA editing summary not available.
")
```

         x=sprintf("EF (%s)", p$control),

} else cat("Editing site data not available.
