## All Mismatch Types (M19 — JACUSA2)

> All base-substitution mismatches detected by JACUSA2 (A→G, C→T, A→C, A→T, C→A, C→G, G→A, G→C, G→T, T→A, T→C, T→G). Filtered for sites supported by ≥3 reads and >5% mismatch frequency per condition.

```{r editing-all-types, fig.height=6, fig.width=10, fig.cap="Mean editing frequency (EF) per mismatch type, split by condition (control = EF1, treatment = EF2). Error bars = SEM across sites. Wilcoxon p-value shown for each type (treatment vs control EF per site). Red = ADAR canonical (A→G); blue = APOBEC canonical (C→T); grey = other types. Only types with ≥10 supporting sites are shown."}
if (!is.null(editing_sites_all) && nrow(editing_sites_all) > 0) {
  mut_col <- if ("mutation_type" %in% colnames(editing_sites_all)) "mutation_type" else
             if ("edit_type"     %in% colnames(editing_sites_all)) "edit_type" else NULL
  if (!is.null(mut_col) && all(c("EF1","EF2") %in% colnames(editing_sites_all))) {
    canonical_adar   <- c("AG","A>G","TC","T>C")
    canonical_apobec <- c("CT","C>T","GA","G>A")

    type_ef <- editing_sites_all |>
      group_by(.data[[mut_col]]) |>
      summarise(
        n_sites  = n(),
        mean_EF1 = mean(EF1, na.rm=TRUE),
        sem_EF1  = sd(EF1, na.rm=TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(EF1))),
        mean_EF2 = mean(EF2, na.rm=TRUE),
        sem_EF2  = sd(EF2, na.rm=TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(EF2))),
        wilcox_p = tryCatch(
          wilcox.test(EF2, EF1, paired=FALSE, exact=FALSE)$p.value,
          error=function(e) NA_real_),
        .groups="drop"
      ) |>
      filter(n_sites >= 10) |>
      mutate(
        edit_class = case_when(
          .data[[mut_col]] %in% canonical_adar   ~ "ADAR (A→G)",
          .data[[mut_col]] %in% canonical_apobec ~ "APOBEC (C→T)",
          TRUE                                   ~ "other"
        ),
        sig_mark = case_when(
          is.na(wilcox_p)  ~ "",
          wilcox_p < 0.001 ~ "***",
          wilcox_p < 0.01  ~ "**",
          wilcox_p < 0.05  ~ "*",
          TRUE              ~ ""
        ),
        p_label = ifelse(!is.na(wilcox_p), sprintf("p=%.3f", wilcox_p), "")
      ) |>
      arrange(desc(mean_EF2 + mean_EF1))

    # Pivot to long format for grouped bars
    ef_long <- type_ef |>
      tidyr::pivot_longer(c(mean_EF1, mean_EF2),
                          names_to="cond_key", values_to="mean_EF") |>
      mutate(
        condition = ifelse(cond_key == "mean_EF1", p$control, p$treatment),
        sem       = ifelse(cond_key == "mean_EF1", sem_EF1, sem_EF2)
      )

    # y position for p labels (above the taller bar)
    p_pos <- type_ef |>
      mutate(y_pos = pmax(mean_EF1, mean_EF2) + pmax(sem_EF1, sem_EF2) + 0.005)

    col_class <- c("ADAR (A→G)"="#E74C3C", "APOBEC (C→T)"="#3498DB", "other"="#BDC3C7")

    ggplot(ef_long,
           aes(x=reorder(.data[[mut_col]], mean_EF + mean_EF),
               y=mean_EF, fill=edit_class, alpha=condition)) +
      geom_col(position=position_dodge(0.8), width=0.7) +
      geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=pmax(mean_EF-sem,0), ymax=mean_EF+sem),
                    position=position_dodge(0.8), width=0.3, linewidth=0.5,
                    show.legend=FALSE) +
      # Show p-value only if significant
      geom_text(data=p_pos |> filter(nzchar(sig_mark)),
                aes(x=.data[[mut_col]], y=y_pos, label=sig_mark, fill=NULL, alpha=NULL),
                size=4.5, fontface="bold", color="#C0392B", inherit.aes=FALSE) +
      scale_fill_manual(values=col_class, name="Editing class") +
      scale_alpha_manual(values=setNames(c(0.55, 1.0), c(p$control, p$treatment)),
                         name="Condition") +
      coord_flip() +
      labs(title=sprintf("RNA mismatch types: mean EF per condition (%s vs %s)",
                         p$treatment, p$control),
           subtitle="Bars = mean EF ± SEM across sites. * p<0.05, ** p<0.01, *** p<0.001 (Wilcoxon, site-level)",
           x="Mismatch type", y="Mean editing frequency") +
      theme_minimal(base_size=12)
  } else {
    cat("Column 'mutation_type'/'edit_type' or EF1/EF2 not found in editing_sites_all.tsv.\n")
    cat(sprintf("Available columns: %s\n", paste(colnames(editing_sites_all), collapse=", ")))
  }
} else {
  cat("All-type editing data not available (editing_sites_all.tsv not generated by M19).\n")
  cat("Re-run M19 to extract all mismatch types from the JACUSA2 output.\n")
}
```

### Differential Editing Activity per Mismatch Type

> For each mismatch type, editing frequency per site is compared between conditions using a Wilcoxon rank-sum test (sites present in both conditions). A>G (ADAR) and C>T (APOBEC) are the canonical RNA editing types. Asymmetry in other types (e.g. G>A, T>C) can reflect DNA damage signatures or sequencing artefacts and should be interpreted with caution.

```{r editing-diff-by-type, fig.height=6, fig.width=11, fig.cap="Per-mismatch-type comparison of editing frequency between conditions. Left: mean EF per condition (only types with ≥10 sites); right: Wilcoxon p-value and log2FC of EF. Red = ADAR canonical (A>G/T>C), blue = APOBEC canonical (C>T/G>A), grey = other."}
if (!is.null(editing_sites_all) && nrow(editing_sites_all) > 0 &&
    "mutation_type" %in% colnames(editing_sites_all)) {
  mut_col <- "mutation_type"
  canonical_adar  <- c("A>G","T>C")
  canonical_apobec <- c("C>T","G>A")

  type_stats <- editing_sites_all |>
    group_by(.data[[mut_col]]) |>
    summarise(
      n_sites    = n(),
      mean_EF1   = mean(EF1, na.rm=TRUE),
      mean_EF2   = mean(EF2, na.rm=TRUE),
      median_EF1 = median(EF1, na.rm=TRUE),
      median_EF2 = median(EF2, na.rm=TRUE),
      wilcox_p   = tryCatch(
        wilcox.test(EF2, EF1, paired=FALSE, exact=FALSE)$p.value,
        error=function(e) NA_real_),
      .groups="drop"
    ) |>
    filter(n_sites >= 10) |>
    mutate(
      log2FC_EF  = log2((mean_EF2 + 1e-4) / (mean_EF1 + 1e-4)),
      padj       = p.adjust(wilcox_p, method="BH"),
      sig        = !is.na(padj) & padj < 0.05,
      edit_class = case_when(
        .data[[mut_col]] %in% canonical_adar   ~ "ADAR (A-to-I)",
        .data[[mut_col]] %in% canonical_apobec ~ "APOBEC (C-to-U)",
        TRUE                                   ~ "other"
      )
    ) |>
    arrange(wilcox_p)

  col_class <- c("ADAR (A-to-I)"="#E74C3C",
                 "APOBEC (C-to-U)"="#3498DB",
                 "other"="#BDC3C7")

  # Left: mean EF per condition
  ef_long <- type_stats |>
    select(.data[[mut_col]], mean_EF1, mean_EF2, edit_class, n_sites) |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(c(mean_EF1, mean_EF2),
                        names_to="condition", values_to="mean_EF") |>
    mutate(condition=ifelse(condition=="mean_EF1", p$control, p$treatment))

  p_ef <- ggplot(ef_long,
                 aes(x=reorder(.data[[mut_col]], mean_EF),
                     y=mean_EF, fill=edit_class, alpha=condition)) +
    geom_col(position="dodge") +
    scale_fill_manual(values=col_class, name="Editing class") +
    scale_alpha_manual(values=setNames(c(0.6,1.0), c(p$control, p$treatment)),
                       name="Condition") +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(title="Mean EF per mismatch type",
         x=NULL, y="Mean editing frequency") +
    theme_minimal(base_size=11)

  # Right: log2FC EF vs -log10(p)
  p_vol <- ggplot(type_stats,
                  aes(x=log2FC_EF, y=-log10(pmax(wilcox_p, 1e-10)),
                      color=edit_class, label=.data[[mut_col]], size=n_sites)) +
    geom_point(alpha=0.9) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(size=3, max.overlaps=20) +
    geom_hline(yintercept=-log10(0.05), linetype="dashed", color="grey50") +
    geom_vline(xintercept=0, linetype="dashed", color="grey70") +
    scale_color_manual(values=col_class, name="Editing class") +
    scale_size_continuous(range=c(3,9), name="N sites") +
    labs(title=sprintf("EF change: %s vs %s", p$treatment, p$control),
         x=sprintf("log2FC mean EF (%s/%s)", p$treatment, p$control),
         y="-log10(Wilcoxon p)") +
    theme_minimal(base_size=11)

  gridExtra::grid.arrange(p_ef, p_vol, ncol=2)
  # Save type_stats for table chunk below
  .type_stats_df <- type_stats
  .mut_col_saved <- mut_col
} else {
  cat("All-type editing data not available for differential analysis.\n")
  .type_stats_df <- NULL
  .mut_col_saved <- NULL
}
```

```{r editing-diff-by-type-table, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
# Table in separate chunk (results='asis') to avoid raw HTML leaking into plots
if (!is.null(.type_stats_df) && nrow(.type_stats_df) > 0) {
  cat("\n**Differential editing by type (BH-corrected):**\n\n")
  .type_stats_df |>
    mutate(across(c(mean_EF1, mean_EF2, log2FC_EF), ~round(., 4)),
           wilcox_p=round(wilcox_p, 4), padj=round(padj, 4)) |>
    select(.data[[.mut_col_saved]], n_sites, mean_EF1, mean_EF2,
           log2FC_EF, wilcox_p, padj, edit_class) |>
    dplyr::rename(mutation_type=1,
                  !!paste0("mean_EF_", p$control)  := mean_EF1,
                  !!paste0("mean_EF_", p$treatment) := mean_EF2) |>
    knitr::kable(caption="Differential editing frequency by mismatch type. BH-corrected p-value. Types with padj<0.05 are statistically significant.") |>
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options=c("striped","condensed"), full_width=FALSE)
}
```

### ADAR Editing Sites in TE Loci (Alu/IR-Alu)

> Inverted Alu repeats (IR-Alu) form double-stranded RNA hairpin structures that are the primary substrate for ADAR1/2-mediated A-to-I editing. In chromatin-associated RNA, edited dsRNA regions within Alu elements reflect changes in TE transcriptional activity and local chromatin structure. Mitotic chromatin compaction is expected to alter accessibility of IR-Alu pairs, potentially changing editing efficiency.

```{r adar-te-overlap, fig.height=5, fig.width=9, fig.cap="ADAR editing sites (A>G) overlapping TE loci from RepeatMasker hg38. Left: proportion of editing sites in each TE macrocategory vs intergenic/non-TE. Right: for sites in Alu elements, editing frequency comparison between conditions."}
if (!is.null(editing_sites) && nrow(editing_sites) > 0 &&
    !is.null(rmsk_bed) && nrow(rmsk_bed) > 0 && .gr_available) {

  GR  <- GenomicRanges::GRanges
  IR  <- IRanges::IRanges

  # Build GRanges for editing sites
  ed_gr <- GR(
    seqnames = editing_sites$chrom,
    ranges   = IR(start=editing_sites$start + 1, end=editing_sites$end),
    strand   = if ("strand" %in% colnames(editing_sites))
                 editing_sites$strand else "*"
  )
  GenomicRanges::mcols(ed_gr) <- editing_sites[, intersect(c("EF1","EF2","dEF","score"),
                                                             colnames(editing_sites))]

  # Build GRanges for rmsk (parse TE name = first part before |)
  rmsk_bed$te_name <- sub("\\|.*","", rmsk_bed$name)
  rmsk_gr <- GR(
    seqnames = rmsk_bed$chrom,
    ranges   = IR(start=rmsk_bed$start + 1, end=rmsk_bed$end),
    strand   = rmsk_bed$strand
  )
  GenomicRanges::mcols(rmsk_gr)$te_name <- rmsk_bed$te_name

  # Find overlaps
  hits    <- GenomicRanges::findOverlaps(ed_gr, rmsk_gr, ignore.strand=TRUE)
  n_total <- length(ed_gr)

  if (length(hits) > 0) {
    ed_idx   <- S4Vectors::queryHits(hits)   # nolint
    rmsk_idx <- S4Vectors::subjectHits(hits) # nolint
    te_names <- GenomicRanges::mcols(rmsk_gr)$te_name[rmsk_idx]
    te_macro <- classify_macro(te_names)

    # Keep first hit per editing site (nearest/first TE)
    ov_df <- data.frame(
      ed_idx=ed_idx, te_name=te_names, te_macro=te_macro
    ) |> dplyr::distinct(ed_idx, .keep_all=TRUE)

    n_in_te <- length(unique(ov_df$ed_idx))
    n_not_te <- n_total - n_in_te

    # Pie / bar: distribution by TE macro
    macro_cnt <- ov_df |>
      count(te_macro, name="n") |>
      add_row(te_macro="non-TE / intergenic", n=n_not_te) |>
      mutate(pct=round(100*n/n_total,1))

    p_bar <- ggplot(macro_cnt,
                    aes(x=reorder(te_macro, n), y=n,
                        fill=ifelse(te_macro=="non-TE / intergenic","grey",te_macro))) +
      geom_col(show.legend=FALSE) +
      geom_text(aes(label=sprintf("%d\n(%.1f%%)",n,pct)),
                hjust=-0.05, size=3) +
      scale_fill_manual(values=c(col_macro,
                                  "non-TE / intergenic"="#BDC3C7",
                                  "grey"="#BDC3C7")) +
      coord_flip() +
      scale_y_continuous(expand=expansion(mult=c(0,0.3))) +
      labs(title=sprintf("ADAR A>G sites in TE context (%d/%d, %.1f%%)",
                         n_in_te, n_total, 100*n_in_te/n_total),
           x=NULL, y="Number of editing sites") +
      theme_minimal(base_size=11)

    # Right: Alu sites — EF per condition
    alu_idx <- ov_df$ed_idx[grepl("^Alu|^MIR", ov_df$te_name, ignore.case=TRUE)]
    if (length(alu_idx) >= 5) {
      alu_sites <- editing_sites[alu_idx, ] |>
        tidyr::pivot_longer(c(EF1, EF2), names_to="condition", values_to="EF") |>
        mutate(condition=ifelse(condition=="EF1", p$control, p$treatment))

      p_alu <- ggplot(alu_sites, aes(x=condition, y=EF, fill=condition)) +
        geom_boxplot(outlier.size=0.8, alpha=0.8) +
        geom_jitter(width=0.1, size=0.6, alpha=0.4) +
        scale_fill_manual(values=setNames(c("#85C1E9","#E74C3C"),
                                          c(p$control, p$treatment)),
                          guide="none") +
        labs(title=sprintf("EF at Alu editing sites (%d sites)", length(alu_idx)),
             subtitle=sprintf("Wilcoxon p=%.4f",
               tryCatch(wilcox.test(
                 editing_sites$EF2[alu_idx],
                 editing_sites$EF1[alu_idx], paired=TRUE, exact=FALSE)$p.value,
                 error=function(e) NA_real_)),
             x=NULL, y="Editing frequency") +
        theme_minimal(base_size=11)

      gridExtra::grid.arrange(p_bar, p_alu, ncol=2)
    } else {
      print(p_bar)
    }
  } else {
    cat(sprintf("No overlap between %d A>G editing sites and rmsk_hg38.bed.\n", n_total))
    cat("Check chromosome name compatibility (chr1 vs 1).\n")
  }
} else {
  if (!.gr_available) cat("GenomicRanges not available — install Bioconductor GenomicRanges.\n")
  else if (is.null(rmsk_bed)) cat("rmsk_hg38.bed not loaded (run M11 first).\n")
  else if (is.null(editing_sites) || nrow(editing_sites)==0)
    cat("A-to-I editing sites not available.\n")
}
```

# Metatranscriptomics (M20 — Kraken2/Bracken)

> Reads not mapping to the human reference genome (STAR unmapped) were classified taxonomically using Kraken2 v2.1.3 with the k2_minusb database. Bracken estimated species-level abundances. Homo sapiens reads excluded from microbial analysis.


## Classification Summary

```{r meta-classification}
if (!is.null(meta_summary)) {
  meta_summary |>
    filter(condition %in% c(p$treatment, p$control)) |>
    mutate(pct_classified=paste0(pct_classified,"%")) |>
    select(Sample=sample_id, Condition=condition,
           `Total reads`=total_reads,
           `Classified`=classified,
           `% classified`=pct_classified) |>
    knitr::kable(caption=sprintf("Kraken2 classification rates for unmapped reads — %s vs %s.", p$treatment, p$control)) |>
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options=c("striped","condensed"), full_width=FALSE)
} else {
  cat("Kraken2 classification summary not available (kraken2_classification_summary.tsv missing).\n\n")
  # Fall back to showing per-sample microbial read counts from abundance matrix
  if (!is.null(meta_abund) && nrow(meta_abund) > 0) {
    meta_col3 <- if (!is.null(coldata) && nrow(coldata)>0) coldata else coldata_all
    sids_meta <- meta_col3$sample_id[meta_col3$sample_id %in% colnames(meta_abund)]
    if (length(sids_meta) > 0) {
      micro_totals <- colSums(meta_abund[, sids_meta, drop=FALSE])
      cond_map_m <- setNames(meta_col3$condition, meta_col3$sample_id)
      micro_tbl <- data.frame(
        Sample    = sids_meta,
        Condition = cond_map_m[sids_meta],
        `Microbial reads (Bracken, excl. Homo sapiens)` = as.integer(micro_totals[sids_meta]),
        check.names = FALSE
      )
      knitr::kable(micro_tbl,
        caption=sprintf("Microbial read counts from Bracken (Homo sapiens excluded). These are unmapped reads classified to non-human taxa. The fraction relative to total input reads indicates overall microbial load. Visible in Section 1.4 RNA landscape as 'Microbial' bar. — %s vs %s.", p$treatment, p$control)) |>
        kable_styling(bootstrap_options=c("striped","condensed"), full_width=FALSE)
    }
  }
}

## Microbial Composition

```{r meta-barplot, fig.height=6, fig.width=10, fig.cap="Relative abundance of microbial species in unmapped reads per sample (Homo sapiens excluded). With full data, microbial signatures (viruses, bacteria, fungi) may be detected here."}
if (!is.null(meta_abund) && nrow(meta_abund) > 0) {
  # Use comparison coldata (filtered to 2 conditions)
  meta_coldata <- if (!is.null(coldata) && nrow(coldata)>0) coldata else coldata_all
  sample_cols <- meta_coldata$sample_id[meta_coldata$sample_id %in% colnames(meta_abund)]
  rel_df <- meta_abund |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(all_of(sample_cols),
                        names_to="sample_id", values_to="reads") |>
    left_join(meta_coldata[,c("sample_id","condition")], by="sample_id") |>
    group_by(sample_id, condition) |>
    mutate(rel_abund=reads/sum(reads)*100) |>
    ungroup()

  top_taxa <- rel_df |>
    group_by(name) |>
    summarise(m=mean(rel_abund),.groups="drop") |>
    arrange(desc(m)) |> head(12) |> pull(name)

  rel_df |>
    mutate(taxon=ifelse(name %in% top_taxa, name, "Other")) |>
    group_by(sample_id, condition, taxon) |>
    summarise(rel_abund=sum(rel_abund),.groups="drop") |>
    ggplot(aes(x=sample_id, y=rel_abund, fill=taxon)) +
    geom_col(position="stack") +
    facet_wrap(~condition, scales="free_x") +
    labs(title="Microbial composition (unmapped reads)",
         x=NULL, y="Relative abundance (%)") +
    theme_minimal(base_size=11) +
    theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=30,hjust=1),
          legend.text=element_text(size=8))
} else cat("Microbial abundance data not available.
")

```{r meta-beta-pca, fig.height=5, fig.width=10}
if (!is.null(meta_abund) && nrow(meta_abund) > 0) {
  sample_cols_b <- coldata$sample_id[coldata$sample_id %in% colnames(meta_abund)]
  if (length(sample_cols_b) >= 3) {
    mat_b <- as.matrix(meta_abund[, sample_cols_b])
    # Bray-Curtis dissimilarity
    bc_dist <- if (requireNamespace("vegan", quietly=TRUE)) {
      as.matrix(vegan::vegdist(t(mat_b), method="bray"))
    } else {
      # Manual Bray-Curtis
      n <- ncol(mat_b)
      d <- matrix(0, n, n, dimnames=list(sample_cols_b, sample_cols_b))
      for (i in 1:n) for (j in 1:n) {
        d[i,j] <- sum(abs(mat_b[,i]-mat_b[,j])) / sum(mat_b[,i]+mat_b[,j]+1e-10)
      }
      d
    }
    # PCoA
    pcoa <- cmdscale(bc_dist, k=2, eig=TRUE)
    var_exp <- round(pcoa$eig[1:2]/sum(abs(pcoa$eig))*100, 1)
    pcoa_df <- data.frame(
      sample_id=rownames(pcoa$points),
      PC1=pcoa$points[,1], PC2=pcoa$points[,2]
    ) |> mutate(condition=conditions[sample_id])

    p_pcoa <- ggplot(pcoa_df, aes(x=PC1, y=PC2,
                                   color=condition, label=sample_id)) +
      geom_point(size=5, alpha=0.9) +
      ggrepel::geom_text_repel(size=3, show.legend=FALSE) +
      scale_color_manual(values=col_cond, name=NULL) +
      labs(title="PCoA - Bray-Curtis dissimilarity",
           x=paste0("PC1 (",var_exp[1],"%)"),
           y=paste0("PC2 (",var_exp[2],"%)")) +
      theme_minimal(base_size=12)

    p_heat <- bc_dist |> as.data.frame() |>
      tibble::rownames_to_column("s1") |>
      tidyr::pivot_longer(-s1, names_to="s2", values_to="dist") |>
      ggplot(aes(x=s1, y=s2, fill=dist)) +
      geom_tile() +
      geom_text(aes(label=round(dist,2)), size=3) +
      scale_fill_gradient(low="white", high="#E74C3C", name="BC dist") +
      labs(title="Bray-Curtis distance matrix", x=NULL, y=NULL) +
      theme_minimal(base_size=11) +
      theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=30,hjust=1))

    # fig title (since fig.cap moved here dynamically)
    cat(sprintf("\n*Beta diversity: Bray-Curtis PCoA (left) and distance matrix (right). %s vs %s.*\n", p$treatment, p$control))
    gridExtra::grid.arrange(p_pcoa, p_heat, ncol=2)
  } else {
    cat("Need >= 3 samples for beta diversity analysis.\n")
  }
} else cat("Microbial abundance data not available.\n")
```

## Functional Profiling (M20b — HUMAnN3)

> HUMAnN3 profiles the functional capacity of microbial communities by mapping unmapped reads to the ChocoPhlAn nucleotide database and UniRef90 protein database. Outputs: gene family abundances (UniRef90 RPK), MetaCyc pathway abundances and coverage. HUMAnN3 is computationally intensive (~50 GB databases required). **M20b has not been run for this dataset** — tables below will populate after execution.


```{r humann-pathways}
if (!is.null(humann_paths) && nrow(humann_paths) > 0) {
  df <- humann_paths
  colnames(df) <- sub("_Unmapped[.]out_Abundance.*","", colnames(df))
  colnames(df)[1] <- "Pathway"
  df <- df[, !duplicated(colnames(df))]
  df_top <- df |>
    filter(!grepl("UNMAPPED|UNINTEGRATED", Pathway), !grepl("|", Pathway, fixed=TRUE)) |>
    mutate(mean_abund=rowMeans(across(where(is.numeric)), na.rm=TRUE)) |>
    arrange(desc(mean_abund)) |>
    head(20)
  if (nrow(df_top) > 0 && max(df_top$mean_abund, na.rm=TRUE) > 0) {

    cat("No pathway abundance detected with DEMO databases.
")
    cat("With full ChocoPhlAn + UniRef90, microbial metabolic pathways will appear here.
")
  }
} else {
  cat("HUMAnN3 pathway data not available — run M20b.
")
}

# TE Somatic Insertions (M23)

> Soft-clipped sequences from STAR chimeric alignments were mapped to DFAM 3.9 TE consensus sequences using BWA-MEM. Clusters of TE-mapping clips at the same genomic locus represent candidate TE insertion sites. Somatic candidates = sites detected in the treatment condition (`r params$treatment`) but not in the control (`r params$control`). **Note:** m23 runs on all samples globally; the somatic_candidate flag uses all-sample comparison, not just this pair.


## Insertion Summary

```{r te-insertion-summary}
if (!is.null(te_ins_summary)) {
  knitr::kable(te_ins_summary,
    col.names=c("Metric","Count"),
    caption="TE insertion detection summary (M23).") |>
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options=c("striped","condensed"), full_width=FALSE)
} else cat("TE insertion summary not available.
")
```

## Insertion Clusters
```{r te-insertion-table}
if (!is.null(te_clusters) && nrow(te_clusters) > 0) {
  # Convert Python bool strings to R logical
  if ("somatic_candidate" %in% colnames(te_clusters) &&
      is.character(te_clusters$somatic_candidate))
    te_clusters$somatic_candidate <- te_clusters$somatic_candidate == "True"
  te_clusters |>
    arrange(desc(n_reads_total)) |>
    head(50) |>
    mutate(somatic = ifelse(somatic_candidate, "yes", "no")) |>
    select(any_of(c("chrom","start","end","te_family","te_macro",
                    "n_reads_total","n_normal","n_tumor","n_control","n_treatment",
                    "somatic","gene_name","dist"))) |>
    DT::datatable(
      caption=sprintf("TE insertion clusters (%d total).", nrow(te_clusters)),
      options=list(pageLength=15, scrollX=TRUE,
                   dom="Bfrtip", buttons=c("csv","excel")),
      extensions="Buttons", rownames=FALSE, filter="top")
} else cat("TE insertion cluster data not available.\n")
```

> **Why do cluster counts differ between conditions?** M23 counts soft-clipped reads mapping to TE consensus sequences (DFAM 3.9) at each genomic locus. Differences between conditions reflect: (1) genuine somatic TE insertions present only in one state (mitosis vs interphase); (2) differences in chromatin accessibility affecting soft-clip production — compacted mitotic chromatin may generate more artifactual clips at certain loci; (3) read depth variation between samples. Somatic candidates (`treatment-only`) require ≥1 supporting read in treatment and 0 in control. Interpret with caution: with n=3 replicates, individual-level variation can generate spurious condition-specific clusters.

```{r te-somatic-plot, fig.height=7, fig.width=12, fig.cap="TE insertion clusters by macrocategory and condition origin. 'Shared' = detected in both conditions; '[treatment]-only' = somatic candidate (present in treatment, absent in control); '[control]-only' = candidate absent in treatment. Left: cluster count per macrocategory; right: total supporting reads. Numbers above bars = cluster count."}
if (!is.null(te_clusters) && nrow(te_clusters) > 0) {
  # Determine per-condition count columns (support both n_normal/n_tumor and n_control/n_treatment)
  nc_col <- if ("n_control"   %in% colnames(te_clusters)) "n_control"   else
            if ("n_normal"    %in% colnames(te_clusters)) "n_normal"    else NULL
  nt_col <- if ("n_treatment" %in% colnames(te_clusters)) "n_treatment" else
            if ("n_tumor"     %in% colnames(te_clusters)) "n_tumor"     else NULL

  if (!is.null(nc_col) && !is.null(nt_col)) {
    lbl_ctrl     <- p$control
    lbl_treat    <- p$treatment
    lbl_shared   <- paste0("Shared (", lbl_ctrl, " + ", lbl_treat, ")")
    lbl_treat_only <- paste0(lbl_treat, "-only")
    lbl_ctrl_only  <- paste0(lbl_ctrl, "-only")

    te_plot <- te_clusters |>
      filter(!is.na(te_macro)) |>
      mutate(
        nc = .data[[nc_col]],
        nt = .data[[nt_col]],
        origin = case_when(
          nc > 0 & nt > 0 ~ lbl_shared,
          nt > 0 & nc == 0 ~ lbl_treat_only,
          nc > 0 & nt == 0 ~ lbl_ctrl_only,
          TRUE             ~ "Unknown"
        ),
        origin = factor(origin, levels=c(lbl_treat_only, lbl_shared, lbl_ctrl_only))
      )

    col_vals <- setNames(
      c("#E74C3C", "#85C1E9", "#F0B27A"),
      c(lbl_treat_only, lbl_shared, lbl_ctrl_only))

    p1 <- te_plot |>
      count(te_macro, origin) |>
      ggplot(aes(x=te_macro, y=n, fill=origin)) +
      geom_col(position="dodge") +
      geom_text(aes(label=n), position=position_dodge(0.9),
                vjust=-0.3, size=3) +
      scale_fill_manual(values=col_vals, name="Origin") +
      labs(title="Cluster count by macrocategory and origin",
           x=NULL, y="Number of clusters") +
      theme_minimal(base_size=11) +
      theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=30, hjust=1))

    # Frequency plot: total reads per category × macrocategory
    p2 <- te_plot |>
      group_by(te_macro, origin) |>
      summarise(total_reads=sum(n_reads_total, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop") |>
      ggplot(aes(x=te_macro, y=total_reads, fill=origin)) +
      geom_col(position="dodge") +
      scale_fill_manual(values=col_vals, name="Origin") +
      scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::comma) +
      labs(title="Supporting reads by macrocategory and origin",
           x=NULL, y="Total supporting reads") +
      theme_minimal(base_size=11) +
      theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=30, hjust=1))

    gridExtra::grid.arrange(p1, p2, ncol=2)
    # Save summary for table chunk
    .te_origin_summary <- te_plot |>
      group_by(origin) |>
      summarise(n_clusters=n(), total_reads=sum(n_reads_total, na.rm=TRUE),
                pct_clusters=round(100*n()/nrow(te_plot),1), .groups="drop") |>
      arrange(desc(n_clusters))
  } else {
    cat(sprintf("Per-condition columns (n_control/n_treatment) not found in cluster table.\n"))
    cat(sprintf("Available columns: %s\n", paste(colnames(te_clusters), collapse=", ")))
    .te_origin_summary <- NULL
  }
} else {
  cat("TE cluster data not available.\n")
  .te_origin_summary <- NULL
}
```

```{r te-somatic-summary-table, results='asis', echo=FALSE}

  cat("\n**Cluster summary by origin:**\n\n")
  .te_origin_summary |>
    knitr::kable(col.names=c("Origin","Clusters","Total reads","% of clusters"),
                 caption="TE insertion cluster summary by condition origin. Treatment-only = somatic candidates.") |>
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options=c("striped","condensed"), full_width=FALSE)
}

# Methods

## Reference Data

| Resource | Version/Date | Description |
|----------|-------------|-------------|
| GRCh38 | GENCODE v49 | Primary assembly, no patches |
| Gene annotation | GENCODE v49 GTF | 78,691 loci |
| TE consensus | DFAM 3.9 | 26,292 curated TE families |
| Genomic TE coordinates | UCSC RepeatMasker hg38 (Oct 2022) | 4,519,330 entries |

## Read Processing

Reads trimmed with fastp 0.22.0 (auto adapter detection, Q20, min length 36bp). Genome alignment: STAR 2.7.10b two-pass mode with GENCODE v49 splice site annotation (`--twopassMode Basic`, `--outReadsUnmapped Fastx`). Strandedness inferred per-sample with RSeQC infer_experiment.py; library strandedness set in config (`sequencing.strandedness`). Gene counts: featureCounts (subread 2.0.6), `-t exon -g gene_id -s 2 --fracOverlap 0.1 -p --countReadPairs` (strandedness flag set from config, not from RSeQC detection — RSeQC shows borderline FR due to high failed-assignment fraction typical of chromatin-associated RNA). circRNA detection: STAR chimeric alignments (`--chimOutType SeparateSAMold`, `--chimSegmentMin 20`) → CIRI2 v2.0.6. Unmapped reads classified taxonomically with Kraken2 + Bracken v2.1.3 (paired-end mode, species-level re-estimation). RNA editing: JACUSA2 v2.1.16 call-2 (`-filterNH 1`). TE somatic insertions: soft-clipped sequences from STAR chimeric SAM aligned to DFAM 3.9 TE consensus with BWA-MEM 0.7.18.

## TE Quantification — Pseudochromosome Approach

DFAM 3.9 human-clade TE families concatenated into pseudochromosomes (200N spacers between families). Trimmed R1 and R2 reads mapped independently (Bowtie2 `--very-sensitive-local`, default score-min). Fragment counts deduplicated by read name to avoid double-counting. Satellites: separate pseudochromosome with analogous approach. Locus-level: TEtranscripts 2.2.3 (EM multi-mapping, RepeatMasker hg38 GTF) + custom pysam locus counter.

## Differential Expression

DESeq2 1.50.2. Size factors from stable genes (CV<0.3, baseMean>10; fallback: baseMean>10 when <500 stable genes found). LFC shrinkage: ashr. TE/satellite: `independentFiltering=FALSE`. circRNA (n<3 per group): Wilcoxon rank-sum, BH correction.

## GO / Pathway Enrichment

clusterProfiler: `enrichGO` (BP/MF/CC), `enrichKEGG` (KEGG REST API, hsa), `enrichDO` (DOSE, Disease Ontology). ENSEMBL → ENTREZ mapping via `bitr` (org.Hs.eg.db). Universe: expressed genes (baseMean>0) for canonical genes; 51,934 RepeatMasker-intersected genes for TE host analysis. Gene set size: 10–500.
